CREATE TABLE "d1_migrations" (
		id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		name       TEXT UNIQUE,
		applied_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
	)

CREATE TABLE orgs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (slug GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND slug NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND length(slug) BETWEEN 2 AND 64),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'deleted')),
  default_identity_id TEXT REFERENCES signing_identities (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  branding TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(branding)),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
, branding_dirty_at INTEGER, access_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, config_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, closed_at INTEGER CHECK (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at > 0), purge_after INTEGER CHECK (purge_after IS NULL OR purge_after > 0), purge_started_at INTEGER CHECK (purge_started_at IS NULL OR purge_started_at > 0), purge_voided_at INTEGER CHECK (purge_voided_at IS NULL OR purge_voided_at > 0), purged_at INTEGER CHECK (purged_at IS NULL OR purged_at > 0), closed_identity_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard' CHECK (kind IN ('standard', 'developer')), personal_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users (id))

CREATE TABLE users (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  primary_email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_login_at INTEGER,
  last_roles TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(last_roles))
, access_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, primary_set_amr TEXT CHECK (primary_set_amr IS NULL OR primary_set_amr IN ('oidc', 'magic_link', 'breakglass')))

CREATE TABLE user_emails (
  email TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  verified_via TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verified_via IN ('magic_link', 'oidc', 'admin')),
  verified_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE auth_identities (
  provider TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT NOT NULL,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email_claim TEXT,
  email_verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (email_verified IN (0, 1)),
  groups TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(groups)),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_used_at INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (provider, subject)
)

CREATE TABLE sessions (
  id_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  amr TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (amr IN ('oidc', 'magic_link', 'breakglass')),
  roles TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '["user"]' CHECK (json_valid(roles)),
  csrf_secret TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  idle_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  revoked_at INTEGER,
  ip_prefix TEXT,
  user_agent TEXT
, auth_time INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE magic_links (
  token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT NOT NULL,
  purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sign_in' CHECK (purpose IN ('sign_in', 'verify_email')),
  user_id TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  code_hash TEXT,
  browser_binding_hash TEXT,
  redirect_path TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  consumed_at INTEGER,
  attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  -- Pocket ID identity awaiting email proof (oidc.trustEmail off); linked when the link is consumed.
  pending_identity TEXT CHECK (pending_identity IS NULL OR json_valid(pending_identity))
, invitation_id TEXT REFERENCES org_invitations(id))

CREATE TABLE oidc_flows (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  nonce TEXT NOT NULL,
  code_verifier TEXT NOT NULL,
  redirect_path TEXT,
  browser_binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
, retried INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (retried IN (0, 1)), step_up_started_at INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE api_keys (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  prefix TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  key_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  scopes TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(scopes)),
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_used_at INTEGER,
  expires_at INTEGER,
  revoked_at INTEGER
, mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live' CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')), kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'service' CHECK (kind IN ('service', 'personal', 'platform')), secret_label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wlt', roles TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(roles) AND json_type(roles) = 'array'), membership_id TEXT REFERENCES org_memberships (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, retire_at INTEGER, restricted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (restricted IN (0, 1)), ip_allow TEXT CHECK (ip_allow IS NULL OR (json_valid(ip_allow) AND json_type(ip_allow) = 'array')), rate_tier TEXT CHECK (rate_tier IS NULL OR rate_tier IN ('standard', 'high', 'bulk')), last_ip_prefix TEXT, parent_key_id TEXT REFERENCES api_keys (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, rotated_from TEXT, created_by_key TEXT, created_amr TEXT CHECK (created_amr IS NULL OR created_amr IN ('oidc', 'magic_link', 'breakglass')))

CREATE TABLE credentials (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('pass_signer', 'connector', 'webhook')),
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
  fingerprint TEXT,
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  rotated_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE signing_identities (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  pass_type_identifier TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  team_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('env', 'db')),
  env_prefix TEXT,
  credential_id TEXT REFERENCES credentials (id),
  cert_pem TEXT,
  cert_sha256 TEXT,
  not_before INTEGER,
  not_after INTEGER,
  apns_binding TEXT,
  apns_health TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (apns_health IN ('unknown', 'healthy', 'failing')),
  nfc_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (nfc_enabled IN (0, 1)),
  is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_default IN (0, 1)),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (typeof(revision) = 'integer' AND revision > 0), env_material_sha256 TEXT, provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'own'
  CHECK (provenance IN ('platform', 'managed', 'own')), issuing INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (issuing IN (0, 1)), rotation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual'
  CHECK (rotation IN ('auto', 'csr', 'manual')), next_rotation_at INTEGER, asc_pass_type_id TEXT, asc_account TEXT, handle TEXT REFERENCES identity_handles (handle),
  CHECK ((source = 'env' AND env_prefix IS NOT NULL) OR (source = 'db' AND credential_id IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE templates (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('baked', 'uploaded')),
  active_version TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),
  styles TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(styles)),
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, reissued_version TEXT, blueprint INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (blueprint IN (0, 1)), source_blueprint TEXT REFERENCES templates (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, shared INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (shared IN (0, 1)),
  UNIQUE (org_id, slug)
)

CREATE TABLE template_versions (
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  version TEXT NOT NULL,
  manifest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(manifest)),
  pass_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(pass_json)),
  assets TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(assets)),
  report TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(report)),
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, build_key TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (template_id, version)
)

CREATE TABLE connections (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  connector_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  connector_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  config TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(config)),
  credential_id TEXT REFERENCES credentials (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  webhook_credential_id TEXT REFERENCES credentials (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  mapping TEXT CHECK (mapping IS NULL OR json_valid(mapping)),
  default_template_id TEXT REFERENCES templates (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  holder_email_field TEXT,
  auto_create INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (auto_create IN (0, 1)),
  auto_email INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (auto_email IN (0, 1)),
  on_missing TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'flag' CHECK (on_missing IN ('keep', 'flag', 'void')),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'poll' CHECK (mode IN ('poll', 'webhook', 'hybrid', 'manual', 'snapshot')),
  interval_seconds INTEGER CHECK (interval_seconds IS NULL OR interval_seconds >= 60),
  max_concurrency INTEGER CHECK (max_concurrency IS NULL OR max_concurrency BETWEEN 1 AND 20),
  requests_per_minute INTEGER CHECK (requests_per_minute IS NULL OR requests_per_minute BETWEEN 1 AND 6000),
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  health TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown'
    CHECK (health IN ('unknown', 'healthy', 'degraded', 'failing', 'paused', 'disabled')),
  consecutive_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  breaker_open_until INTEGER,
  cursor TEXT,
  next_run_at INTEGER,
  last_run_at INTEGER,
  last_success_at INTEGER,
  last_error_code TEXT,
  last_error_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
, void_when TEXT
  CHECK (void_when IS NULL OR (json_valid(void_when) AND json_type(void_when) = 'array'
    AND json_array_length(void_when) <= 8)), webhook_prev_credential_id TEXT
  REFERENCES credentials (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, webhook_prev_until INTEGER
  CHECK (webhook_prev_credential_id IS NULL OR webhook_prev_until IS NOT NULL), webhook_secret_fp TEXT, webhook_prev_secret_fp TEXT)

CREATE TABLE connection_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  trigger TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trigger IN ('schedule', 'webhook', 'admin', 'user', 'test', 'backfill')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  pass_id TEXT,
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  finished_at INTEGER,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running'
    CHECK (outcome IN ('running', 'unchanged', 'changed', 'error', 'skipped')),
  records_seen INTEGER,
  passes_changed INTEGER,
  error_code TEXT,
  error_detail TEXT,
  http_status INTEGER,
  duration_ms INTEGER
, passes_created INTEGER, passes_voided INTEGER, records_failed INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE webhook_events (
  connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (connection_id, event_id)
)

CREATE TABLE passes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id),
  identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES signing_identities (id),
  serial TEXT NOT NULL,
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  template_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  auth_token TEXT NOT NULL,
  download_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  download_token_rotated_at INTEGER,
  web_service_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  personalization TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(personalization)),
  field_sources TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(field_sources)),
  display_title TEXT,
  display_subtitle TEXT,
  external_id TEXT,
  -- One holder per pass. State: unassigned (no email, no owner), waiting (email, no owner), owned.
  holder_email TEXT,
  owner_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'voided')),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  object_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  object_sha256 TEXT,
  object_size INTEGER,
  content_hash TEXT,
  deleted_at INTEGER,
  modified_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  modified_collision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  connection_id TEXT REFERENCES connections (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  external_ref TEXT,
  link_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  next_sync_at INTEGER,
  last_synced_at INTEGER,
  sync_error_code TEXT,
  sync_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  refresh_requested_at INTEGER,
  last_refreshed_at INTEGER,
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  -- Set by the application in the same statement that changes object_key; the triggers consume them.
  pending_cause TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin'
    CHECK (pending_cause IN ('create', 'admin', 'api', 'connection', 'user_refresh', 'template_upgrade', 'resign')),
  pending_actor_type TEXT,
  pending_actor_id TEXT,
  pending_pass_json TEXT, mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live' CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')), barcode_hash TEXT, scan_code TEXT, removed_at INTEGER, pending_source TEXT, lookup_hash TEXT, removal_message TEXT, removal_prior_status TEXT, test_data_quarantined INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  CHECK (test_data_quarantined IN (0, 1)), lifecycle_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  CHECK (lifecycle_generation >= 0), removal_published_generation INTEGER, removal_claim_version INTEGER, removal_claim_status TEXT
  CHECK (removal_claim_status IS NULL OR removal_claim_status IN ('active', 'voided')), removal_claim_object_key TEXT, removal_claim_link_generation INTEGER, release_id TEXT REFERENCES template_releases(id), row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, credential_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  CHECK (typeof(credential_generation) = 'integer'
    AND credential_generation BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), image_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  CHECK (typeof(image_generation) = 'integer' AND image_generation BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), write_ref TEXT,
  UNIQUE (identity_id, serial),
  FOREIGN KEY (template_id, template_version) REFERENCES template_versions (template_id, version)
)

CREATE TABLE pass_versions (
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  object_key TEXT,
  object_sha256 TEXT,
  template_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  personalization TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(personalization)),
  pass_json TEXT,
  cause TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (cause IN ('create', 'admin', 'api', 'connection', 'user_refresh', 'template_upgrade', 'resign')),
  actor_type TEXT,
  actor_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  purged_at INTEGER, source TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (pass_id, version)
)

CREATE TABLE pass_attach_blocks (
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (pass_id, user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE pass_assets (
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  r2_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  sha1 TEXT NOT NULL,
  size INTEGER NOT NULL,
  width INTEGER,
  height INTEGER,
  crc32 INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (pass_id, name)
)

CREATE TABLE devices (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES signing_identities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  push_token TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (device_id, identity_id)
)

CREATE TABLE registrations (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  identity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, push_token TEXT, credential_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  CHECK (typeof(credential_generation) = 'integer'
    AND credential_generation BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
  PRIMARY KEY (device_id, identity_id, pass_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id, identity_id) REFERENCES devices (device_id, identity_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE revisions (
  revision INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE outbox (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('push', 'email')),
  pass_id TEXT REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  coalesce_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(payload)),
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'enqueued', 'processing', 'sent', 'partial', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8,
  available_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  enqueued_at INTEGER,
  lease TEXT,
  provider_id TEXT,
  error_code TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  finished_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE push_results (
  outbox_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES outbox (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  http_status INTEGER,
  reason TEXT,
  apns_id TEXT,
  at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (outbox_id, device_id)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_logs (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  identity_id TEXT,
  line TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE settings (
  scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('platform', 'system') OR scope GLOB 'org:*'),
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(value)),
  updated_by TEXT,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (scope, key)
)

CREATE TABLE idempotency_keys (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  resource_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, key)
)

CREATE TABLE counters (
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  window_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (key, window_start)
)

CREATE TABLE connection_inbox (
  connection_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  ref TEXT NOT NULL,
  record TEXT CHECK (record IS NULL OR json_valid(record)),
  deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (deleted IN (0, 1)),
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (connection_id, event_id, ref),
  FOREIGN KEY (connection_id, event_id) REFERENCES webhook_events (connection_id, event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE pass_personalizations (
  pass_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  published_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE "template_imports" (
  upload_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT,
  object_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  step TEXT,
  template_id TEXT,
  version TEXT,
  report TEXT CHECK (report IS NULL OR json_valid(report)),
  error TEXT,
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE pass_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live' CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  -- A closed list, validated by the app (src/shared/contracts/events.ts), so a new kind needs no migration.
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- First 12 hex characters of SHA-256(device id); never the device id.
  device TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT,
  actor_id TEXT,
  data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(data)),
  at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE bundles (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live' CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- Stored retrievably, like passes.download_token: links are re-sent.
  token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  token_rotated_at INTEGER,
  holder_email TEXT,
  created_by_type TEXT,
  created_by_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE bundle_passes (
  bundle_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (bundle_id, pass_id)
)

CREATE TABLE apns_keys (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  team_identifier TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  key_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  rotated_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE broadcasts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live' CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('message', 'change')),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft', 'scheduled', 'sending', 'sent', 'partial', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
  target TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(target)),
  patch TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(patch)),
  notify INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  at INTEGER,
  -- Milliseconds after the start that a message is cleared again.
  clear_after INTEGER,
  -- A follow-up only clears passes still showing this text: JSON of the input values to match.
  expect TEXT CHECK (expect IS NULL OR json_valid(expect)),
  parent_id TEXT REFERENCES broadcasts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  targeted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  error_code TEXT,
  created_by_type TEXT,
  created_by_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  started_at INTEGER,
  finished_at INTEGER
, checked_at INTEGER, rule_id TEXT, window_key TEXT, stop_at INTEGER, instance TEXT, retry_of TEXT, snapshot_at INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE broadcast_items (
  broadcast_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES broadcasts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('updated', 'unchanged', 'failed')),
  -- 1 when the update went out without a notification because of the daily limit.
  silent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, before TEXT CHECK (before IS NULL OR json_valid(before)), version INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (broadcast_id, pass_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE scan_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  match_input TEXT,
  match_values TEXT CHECK (match_values IS NULL OR json_valid(match_values)),
  opens_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  closes_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  time_zone TEXT NOT NULL,
  capacity INTEGER CHECK (capacity IS NULL OR capacity > 0),
  reentry INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reentry IN (0, 1)),
  note TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 140),   -- staff note; the only display-adjacent event field
  expected INTEGER,                -- cached denominator, refreshed at most once a minute
  expected_at INTEGER,
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  archived_at INTEGER, config_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, hard_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (hard_limit IN (0, 1)), setup_key TEXT,
  CHECK (closes_at > opens_at),
  CHECK ((match_input IS NULL) = (match_values IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE scan_event_templates (
  event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scan_events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  PRIMARY KEY (event_id, template_id)
)

CREATE TABLE scan_staff (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('door', 'desk', 'manager')),
  pin_hash TEXT NOT NULL,          -- HMAC-SHA256(K_pin, id:pin)
  pin_set_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  disabled_at INTEGER,
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
, auth_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, pin_mac_version INTEGER, pin_tag TEXT, pin_reset_required INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pin_issued_at INTEGER, pin_issued_binding TEXT, pin_issue_repeats INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE scanners (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('device', 'terminal', 'display')),  -- a display never scans; a terminal always does
  device_role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scan' CHECK (device_role IN ('scan', 'customer', 'monitor')),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_id TEXT REFERENCES scan_events (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  settings TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(settings)),
  time_zone TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_prefix TEXT UNIQUE,
  token_hash TEXT,
  csrf_secret TEXT,
  pair_code_hash TEXT UNIQUE,
  pair_expires_at INTEGER,

  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  revoked_at INTEGER, credential_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, config_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, contact_at INTEGER, contact_prev_at INTEGER, online_since INTEGER,
  CHECK ((token_hash IS NULL) = (token_prefix IS NULL)),
  CHECK (kind <> 'terminal' OR csrf_secret IS NULL),
  CHECK (kind <> 'terminal' OR device_role = 'scan'),
  CHECK (kind <> 'display' OR device_role <> 'scan')
)

CREATE TABLE scanner_templates (

CREATE TABLE scans (

  template_id TEXT,
  scanner_id TEXT,
  event_id TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('scanner', 'user', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  staff_id TEXT,
  approved_by TEXT,                -- scan_staff id of the approving Manager
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('camera', 'wedge', 'nfc', 'manual', 'auto')),
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'done', 'failed')),
  outcome TEXT CHECK (outcome IN ('ok', 'heads_up', 'refused')),

CREATE TABLE scan_gates (

CREATE TABLE vas_keys (

  UNIQUE(id,org_id)
)

CREATE TABLE scanning_devices (

  overrides TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(overrides)),

  reported_at INTEGER,
  admin_user_id TEXT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  device_key TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY(session_id,org_id) REFERENCES scanning_sessions(id,org_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(scanner_id,org_id) REFERENCES scanners(id,org_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE sandbox_forwards (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  capture_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES captured_emails (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL,
  bundle_id TEXT REFERENCES bundles (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL,
  actor_id TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL,
  email TEXT REFERENCES user_emails (email) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE SET NULL,
  intent TEXT NOT NULL,
  pass_ids TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    json_valid(pass_ids) AND json_type(pass_ids) = 'array' AND json_array_length(pass_ids) > 0
  ),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('sending', 'sent', 'failed', 'unknown', 'expired')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  finished_at INTEGER,
  -- A reservation that outlives its lease (or stays unknown for a day) becomes 'expired', which
  -- releases the data locks below (they test state IN ('sending', 'unknown')). Org suspension and
  -- user disable are kill switches and are never blocked by a reservation.
  lease_until INTEGER,
  CHECK (state != 'sending' OR lease_until IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (state NOT IN ('sending', 'unknown') OR (
    org_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_id IS NOT NULL AND email IS NOT NULL
  ))
)

CREATE TABLE sandbox_forward_passes (
  forward_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sandbox_forwards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

)

CREATE TABLE org_invitations (

  token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  revoked_at INTEGER,
  accepted_at INTEGER,

CREATE TABLE template_candidates (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('apple', 'google', 'samsung')),
  version TEXT NOT NULL,
  candidate_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(candidate_hash) = 64 AND candidate_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_hash) = 64 AND content_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  adapter_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (adapter_revision > 0),
  adapter_capabilities TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(adapter_capabilities) AND json_type(adapter_capabilities) = 'array'),
  audience_policy_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (audience_policy_revision > 0),
  author_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  version_author_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, source_release_id TEXT REFERENCES template_releases(id), source_release_generation INTEGER, source_release_hash TEXT, projection_json TEXT, provider_account_id TEXT REFERENCES wallet_provider_accounts(id), provider_account_revision INTEGER, provider_identity_hash TEXT, credential_keyset_commitment TEXT
  CHECK(credential_keyset_commitment IS NULL OR (typeof(credential_keyset_commitment) = 'text'
    AND length(CAST(credential_keyset_commitment AS BLOB)) = 64 AND length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64
    AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), provider_account_epoch INTEGER
  CHECK (provider_account_epoch IS NULL OR (typeof(provider_account_epoch) = 'integer' AND provider_account_epoch > 0)),
  FOREIGN KEY (template_id, version) REFERENCES template_versions(template_id, version)
)

CREATE TABLE template_approvals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_candidates(id),
  candidate_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(candidate_hash) = 64 AND candidate_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  reviewer_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
, credential_keyset_commitment TEXT
  CHECK(credential_keyset_commitment IS NULL OR (typeof(credential_keyset_commitment) = 'text'
    AND length(CAST(credential_keyset_commitment AS BLOB)) = 64 AND length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64
    AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'peer'
  CHECK (kind IN ('peer', 'sole', 'test')))

CREATE TABLE template_releases (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('apple', 'google', 'samsung')),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
  version TEXT NOT NULL,
  candidate_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(candidate_hash) = 64 AND candidate_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_hash) = 64 AND content_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  adapter_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (adapter_revision > 0),
  adapter_capabilities TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(adapter_capabilities) AND json_type(adapter_capabilities) = 'array'),
  audience_policy_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (audience_policy_revision > 0),
  -- 'legacy' (cutover amendment): tools/bootstrap-tenancy.ts only, for templates uploaded before reviews existed.
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('approved', 'system', 'legacy')),
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('release', 'rollback', 'system', 'legacy')),
  candidate_id TEXT REFERENCES template_candidates(id),
  approval_id TEXT REFERENCES template_approvals(id),
  previous_release_id TEXT REFERENCES template_releases(id),
  rollback_of_release_id TEXT REFERENCES template_releases(id),
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, credential_keyset_commitment TEXT
  CHECK(credential_keyset_commitment IS NULL OR (typeof(credential_keyset_commitment) = 'text'
    AND length(CAST(credential_keyset_commitment AS BLOB)) = 64 AND length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64
    AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  FOREIGN KEY (template_id, version) REFERENCES template_versions(template_id, version),
  CHECK (
    (source = 'system' AND action = 'system' AND candidate_id IS NULL AND approval_id IS NULL
      AND rollback_of_release_id IS NULL AND created_by IS NULL)
    OR (source = 'legacy' AND action = 'legacy' AND candidate_id IS NULL AND approval_id IS NULL
      AND rollback_of_release_id IS NULL AND previous_release_id IS NULL AND generation = 1)
    OR (source = 'approved' AND action = 'release' AND candidate_id IS NOT NULL AND approval_id IS NOT NULL
      AND rollback_of_release_id IS NULL AND created_by IS NOT NULL)
    OR (source = 'approved' AND action = 'rollback' AND candidate_id IS NOT NULL AND approval_id IS NOT NULL
      AND rollback_of_release_id IS NOT NULL AND created_by IS NOT NULL)
  )
)

CREATE TABLE template_release_reissues (

CREATE TABLE connection_webhook_retention (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  connection_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('ingress', 'legacy', 'legacy_duplicate_unproven', 'legacy_cleanup_unproven')),
  connection_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (connection_mode IN ('webhook', 'hybrid', 'unknown')),
  reference_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reference_mode IN ('embedded-required', 'refs-only', 'unknown')),
  ref_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'failed', 'blocked', 'resolved', 'ignored')),
  error_code TEXT,
  release_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(release_snapshot)),
  snapshot_known INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (snapshot_known IN (0, 1)),
  dispatch_complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (dispatch_complete IN (0, 1)),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0),
  item_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (item_count >= 0),
  chunk_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (chunk_count > 0),
  replay_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (replay_generation >= 0),
  last_replay_id TEXT,
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, credential_keyset_commitment TEXT
  CHECK (credential_keyset_commitment IS NULL OR
    (length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64 AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  UNIQUE (connection_id, event_id, ref_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE connection_webhook_items (

  country_code TEXT NOT NULL,

  testing_mode_off TEXT CHECK(testing_mode_off IS NULL OR testing_mode_off IN ('Y', 'N')),
  probe_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  verified_at INTEGER,
  expires_at INTEGER, credential_keyset_commitment TEXT
  CHECK(credential_keyset_commitment IS NULL OR (typeof(credential_keyset_commitment) = 'text'
    AND length(CAST(credential_keyset_commitment AS BLOB)) = 64 AND length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64
    AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), account_epoch INTEGER
  CHECK (account_epoch IS NULL OR (typeof(account_epoch) = 'integer' AND account_epoch > 0)),
  CHECK((status = 'verified' AND testing_mode_off IS NOT NULL AND testing_mode_off = 'Y' AND verified_at IS NOT NULL
      AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at > verified_at AND expires_at <= verified_at + 300000)

CREATE TABLE pass_credential_transfers (
  id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'completed')),
  source_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(source_generation) = 'integer'
    AND source_generation BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740990),
  target_generation INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (source_generation + 1) STORED,
  source_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(source_version) = 'integer' AND source_version > 0),
  source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(source_revision) = 'integer' AND source_revision >= 0),
  -- Staleness of the source read (authority-epochs.md section 1.1). version and revision are recorded for
  -- the audit trail and the provider-track fences; the guards below compare row_version instead.
  source_row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (typeof(source_row_version) = 'integer' AND source_row_version > 0),
  source_lifecycle_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(source_lifecycle_generation) = 'integer' AND source_lifecycle_generation >= 0),
  source_link_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(source_link_generation) = 'integer' AND source_link_generation > 0),
  -- Connector authority and the admitted release are captured rather than reconstructed on retry.
  source_connection_id TEXT,
  source_connection_ref TEXT,
  source_connection_generation INTEGER,
  source_connection_mode TEXT,
  source_admitted_release_id TEXT,
  source_admitted_release_generation INTEGER,
  source_admitted_release_version TEXT,
  target_holder_email TEXT,
  target_owner_user_id TEXT,
  requested_by_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (requested_by_type IN ('user', 'api_key', 'system', 'connection', 'scanner')),
  requested_by_id TEXT,
  requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(requested_at) = 'integer' AND requested_at >= 0),
  completed_at INTEGER,
  CHECK ((state = 'pending' AND completed_at IS NULL)
    OR (state = 'completed' AND typeof(completed_at) = 'integer' AND completed_at >= requested_at)),
  CHECK (
    (source_connection_id IS NULL AND source_connection_ref IS NULL
      AND source_connection_generation IS NULL AND source_connection_mode IS NULL
      AND source_admitted_release_id IS NULL AND source_admitted_release_generation IS NULL
      AND source_admitted_release_version IS NULL)
    OR (source_connection_id IS NOT NULL AND length(source_connection_id) > 0
      AND typeof(source_connection_generation) = 'integer' AND source_connection_generation > 0
      AND source_connection_mode IS NOT NULL
      AND source_connection_mode IN ('poll', 'webhook', 'hybrid', 'manual', 'snapshot')
      AND source_admitted_release_id IS NOT NULL AND length(source_admitted_release_id) > 0
      AND typeof(source_admitted_release_generation) = 'integer' AND source_admitted_release_generation > 0
      AND source_admitted_release_version IS NOT NULL AND length(source_admitted_release_version) > 0)
  ),
  UNIQUE (pass_id, target_generation)
)

CREATE TABLE pass_transfer_asset_gc (
  r2_key TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(r2_key) > 0),
  transfer_id TEXT,
  source_pass_id TEXT,
  retired_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  -- Only these dedicated namespaces can be erased; an unexpected legacy key might name
  -- organization branding, a template or another kind of object, and must be retained.
  deletion_eligible INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
    CASE WHEN substr(r2_key, 1, 12) = 'pass-assets/'
           OR substr(r2_key, 1, 14) = 'member-photos/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) STORED,
  next_attempt_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  claim_token TEXT,
  claim_until INTEGER,
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  last_deleted_at INTEGER,
  -- A deleted key is checked again a bounded number of times for a late PUT, then settles: the row stays
  -- as the immutable tombstone but leaves the sweep (W1-13).
  rechecks INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (rechecks >= 0),
  settled_at INTEGER,
  CHECK ((transfer_id IS NULL AND source_pass_id IS NULL) OR
         (transfer_id IS NOT NULL AND source_pass_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK ((claim_token IS NULL AND claim_until IS NULL) OR
         (claim_token IS NOT NULL AND claim_until IS NOT NULL))
)
