    AND json_array_length(event_types) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
  template_ids TEXT CHECK (template_ids IS NULL OR (json_valid(template_ids)
    AND json_type(template_ids) = 'array' AND json_array_length(template_ids) BETWEEN 1 AND 20)),
  api_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'paused', 'disabled')),
  disabled_at INTEGER,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  consecutive_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (consecutive_failures >= 0),
  last_success_at INTEGER,
  last_failure_at INTEGER,
  lane_token TEXT,
  lane_until INTEGER,
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'url' CHECK (target IN ('url', 'capture')),
  UNIQUE (id, org_id, mode),
  CHECK ((status = 'disabled') = (disabled_at IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE webhook_endpoint_secrets (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  endpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (kek_version > 0),
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER,                       -- NULL = current
  FOREIGN KEY (endpoint_id, org_id, mode) REFERENCES webhook_endpoints (id, org_id, mode) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE event_feed (
  seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  external_id TEXT,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  device TEXT,
  device_count INTEGER,
  actor_type TEXT,
  data TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(data)),
  at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE webhook_deliveries (
  endpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'delivered', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  next_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_status INTEGER,
  last_error TEXT,
  last_attempt_at INTEGER,
  finished_at INTEGER,
  replays INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (endpoint_id, event_seq),
  FOREIGN KEY (endpoint_id, org_id, mode) REFERENCES webhook_endpoints (id, org_id, mode) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (event_seq, org_id, mode) REFERENCES event_feed (seq, org_id, mode) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CHECK ((state = 'pending') = (finished_at IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE webhook_attempts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  endpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_seq INTEGER,                        -- NULL for a test send
  attempt INTEGER NOT NULL,
  trigger TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trigger IN ('event', 'retry', 'replay', 'test')),
  status INTEGER,
  error_code TEXT,
  duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  at INTEGER NOT NULL, sample_type TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (endpoint_id, org_id, mode) REFERENCES webhook_endpoints (id, org_id, mode) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (event_seq, org_id, mode) REFERENCES event_feed (seq, org_id, mode) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE join_links (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (token GLOB 'h1:*'),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (generation >= 1),
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)),
  name_input TEXT,
  ask_email INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (ask_email IN (0, 1)),
  -- 50 fits both modes; the service always writes the limit it means (200 for a live link by default).
  daily_limit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 50
    CHECK (daily_limit BETWEEN 1 AND 5000 AND (mode = 'live' OR daily_limit <= 50)),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  rotated_at INTEGER,
  created_by TEXT,
  updated_by TEXT,
  UNIQUE (org_id, mode, template_id)
)

CREATE TABLE join_link_seals (
  link_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES join_links (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE join_issues (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  link_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES join_links (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  link_generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ip_key TEXT,
  device_key TEXT,
  fields_hash TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE org_reply_to (
  org_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  address TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_hash TEXT,
  expires_at INTEGER,
  sent_at INTEGER,
  confirmed_at INTEGER,
  CHECK ((token_hash IS NULL) = (expires_at IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE scan_code_rotations (
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  old_code_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(old_code_hash) = 64 AND old_code_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  new_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(new_version) = 'integer' AND new_version >= 1),
  rotated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(rotated_at) = 'integer' AND rotated_at >= 0),
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_id TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (pass_id, new_version)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE retention_floors (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  days INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (days > 0),
  until INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, class)
)
CREATE TABLE retention_platform_rev (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), rev INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE retention_holds (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_id TEXT,
  placed_by_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (placed_by_kind IN ('org', 'platform')),
  placed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  released_at INTEGER,
  released_by TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE retention_receipts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT,
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('sweep', 'visitor', 'erasure')),
  policy_days INTEGER,
  cutoff_at INTEGER,
  deleted INTEGER NOT NULL,
  anonymised INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  request_id TEXT,
  refs_digest TEXT,
  ran_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
  prev_mac TEXT,
  mac TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE retention_receipt_anchors (
  org_id TEXT,
  class TEXT NOT NULL,
  seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
  mac TEXT NOT NULL,
  ran_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  anchor_mac TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE data_requests (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  contact_email TEXT,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('export', 'erasure')),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open', 'erasing', 'on_hold', 'done', 'declined', 'withdrawn')),
  note TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 1000),
  response TEXT CHECK (response IS NULL OR length(response) <= 500),
  decline_reason TEXT,
  export_key TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  due_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  extended_at INTEGER,
  closed_at INTEGER,
  closed_by TEXT,
  row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE data_request_passes (
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES data_requests (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
  pass_id TEXT REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  purged_at INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (request_id, pass_ref)
)

CREATE TABLE connection_ref_versions (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id),
  connection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(ref) <= 200),
  source_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  -- Breaks a tie between records of the same version: the larger event id wins.
  source_event TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (connection_id, ref)
)

CREATE TABLE message_rules (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('on', 'paused')),
  paused_code TEXT,
  template_ids TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(template_ids) AND json_type(template_ids) = 'array'),
  match TEXT CHECK (match IS NULL OR json_valid(match)),
  anchor_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (anchor_kind IN ('input', 'last_scan')),
  anchor_input TEXT CHECK ((anchor_kind = 'input') = (anchor_input IS NOT NULL)),
  offset_amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (offset_amount BETWEEN 0 AND 366),
  offset_unit TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (offset_unit IN ('day', 'hour')),
  offset_when TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (offset_when IN ('before', 'after')),
  yearly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (yearly IN (0, 1)),
  send_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '10:00',
  time_zone TEXT NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  clear_after INTEGER,
  next_check_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER,
  last_broadcast_id TEXT,
  sent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  skipped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_by_type TEXT,
  created_by_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  edited_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE message_rule_fires (
  rule_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES message_rules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  occurrence TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  broadcast_id TEXT,
  fired_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (rule_id, pass_id, occurrence)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE join_marks (
  pass_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE template_channel_policies (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  channels TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(channels) AND json_type(channels) = 'object'),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  updated_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, mode, template_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE pass_channels (
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('mobile', 'apple', 'google', 'samsung', 'paper', 'nfc')),
  override TEXT CHECK (override IN ('on', 'off')),
  retired_at INTEGER,
  retired_cause TEXT CHECK (retired_cause IN ('pass', 'template')),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  set_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  set_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (pass_id, channel)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE pass_channel_copies (
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('mobile', 'apple', 'google', 'samsung', 'paper', 'nfc')),
  copy_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (pass_id, channel)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE authority_grants (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('org', 'org_mode', 'platform')),
  org_id TEXT,
  mode TEXT,
  principal TEXT NOT NULL,
  purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_id TEXT,
  denied TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  leak_guard TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_grant_leaks(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, limit_key TEXT,
  CHECK ((scope = 'platform' AND org_id IS NULL AND mode IS NULL)
      OR (scope = 'org' AND org_id IS NOT NULL AND mode IS NULL)
      OR (scope = 'org_mode' AND org_id IS NOT NULL AND mode IN ('live', 'test'))),
  CHECK (purpose GLOB scope || '.*'),
  CHECK (leak_guard = id),
  CHECK (purpose NOT GLOB '*.connection.*' OR IFNULL(mode, '') = 'live'),
  CHECK (principal NOT GLOB 'system:*' OR purpose GLOB '*.job.*'),
  CHECK (principal NOT GLOB 'holder:*' OR purpose IN ('org_mode.pass.holder_remove', 'org_mode.pass.holder_attach', 'org_mode.nfc.tag.holder_lost')),
  CHECK (principal NOT GLOB 'device:*' OR purpose = 'org_mode.pass.personalize'),
  CHECK (principal NOT GLOB 'link:*' OR purpose = 'org_mode.pass.holder_print'),
  CHECK (principal GLOB 'holder:*' OR principal GLOB 'device:*' OR principal GLOB 'link:*'
    OR purpose NOT IN ('org_mode.pass.holder_remove', 'org_mode.pass.holder_attach', 'org_mode.pass.personalize', 'org_mode.nfc.tag.holder_lost', 'org_mode.pass.holder_print'))
)

CREATE TABLE pass_prints (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  print_code_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(print_code_hash) = 64 AND print_code_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  roster_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(roster_hash) = 32 AND roster_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(generation) = 'integer' AND generation >= 1),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'voided', 'used')),
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  voided_at INTEGER,
  void_cause TEXT, pass_version INTEGER
  CHECK (pass_version IS NULL OR (typeof(pass_version) = 'integer' AND pass_version >= 1)), paper_hash TEXT
  CHECK (paper_hash IS NULL OR (typeof(paper_hash) = 'text' AND length(paper_hash) = 64 AND paper_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  CHECK ((status = 'voided') = (voided_at IS NOT NULL)),
  UNIQUE (pass_id, generation)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_provider_accounts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('google', 'samsung')),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (typeof(revision) = 'integer' AND revision >= 0),
  credential_id TEXT,
  revoked_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hmac_kek_version INTEGER CHECK (hmac_kek_version IS NULL OR hmac_kek_version > 0),
  hmac_iv BLOB,
  hmac_wrapped_dek BLOB,
  hmac_ciphertext BLOB, credential_source_id TEXT REFERENCES wallet_credentials(id), identity_hash TEXT
  CHECK (identity_hash IS NULL OR (length(identity_hash) = 64 AND identity_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), enabled_at INTEGER, enrolment_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  CHECK (typeof(enrolment_revision) = 'integer' AND enrolment_revision >= 0), platform_hold_at INTEGER, platform_hold_reason TEXT, authority_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  CHECK (typeof(authority_epoch) = 'integer' AND authority_epoch >= 1),
  UNIQUE (org_id, mode, provider),
  UNIQUE (id, org_id, mode, provider),
  CHECK ((revision = 0) = (credential_id IS NULL)),
  CHECK ((hmac_kek_version IS NULL) = (hmac_iv IS NULL) AND (hmac_kek_version IS NULL) = (hmac_wrapped_dek IS NULL)
    AND (hmac_kek_version IS NULL) = (hmac_ciphertext IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_credentials (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('platform', 'org')),
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('google', 'samsung')),
  identity_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(identity_hash) = 64 AND identity_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  identity_hint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(identity_hint) BETWEEN 1 AND 4),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (typeof(revision) = 'integer' AND revision >= 0),
  current_version_id TEXT,
  verified_at INTEGER,
  revoked_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'own'
  CHECK (provenance IN ('platform', 'managed', 'own')), signer_ref TEXT REFERENCES wallet_credentials (id), next_rotation_at INTEGER,
  CHECK ((scope = 'platform') = (org_id IS NULL)),
  CHECK (revision > 0 OR current_version_id IS NULL),
  CHECK (current_version_id IS NOT NULL OR revision = 0 OR revoked_at IS NOT NULL),
  FOREIGN KEY (current_version_id, id) REFERENCES wallet_credential_versions(id, credential_id)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_credential_versions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  credential_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_credentials(id),
  identity_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(identity_hash) = 64 AND identity_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  card_map TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(card_map) AND json_type(card_map) = 'object'),
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (kek_version > 0),
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (id, credential_id)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_credential_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  credential_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_credentials(id),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(revision) = 'integer' AND revision > 0),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('create', 'rotate', 'revoke', 'verify')),
  version_id TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('user', 'platform', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  request_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)),
  UNIQUE (credential_id, revision),
  FOREIGN KEY (version_id, credential_id) REFERENCES wallet_credential_versions(id, credential_id),
  CHECK (kind NOT IN ('create', 'rotate') OR version_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (actor_type = 'system' OR actor_id IS NOT NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_credential_checks (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  credential_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_credentials(id),
  version_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  ok INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ok IN (0, 1)),
  code TEXT CHECK (code IS NULL OR length(code) <= 64),
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)),
  FOREIGN KEY (version_id, credential_id) REFERENCES wallet_credential_versions(id, credential_id)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_provider_instances (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('google', 'samsung')),
  account_id TEXT REFERENCES wallet_provider_accounts(id),
  identity_projection_release_id TEXT REFERENCES template_releases(id),
  credential_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(credential_generation) = 'integer' AND credential_generation >= 1),
  channel_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (typeof(channel_epoch) = 'integer' AND channel_epoch BETWEEN 1 AND 16),
  retirement_cause TEXT CHECK (retirement_cause IS NULL OR retirement_cause = 'channel_off'),
  lifecycle TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (lifecycle IN ('blocked', 'ready', 'active', 'revoking', 'revoked', 'retired')),
  desired_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(desired_version) = 'integer' AND desired_version >= 0),
  desired_operation_id TEXT,
  installation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (installation_state = 'unknown'),
  installation_observed_at INTEGER CHECK (installation_observed_at IS NULL),
  revoked_at INTEGER,
  retired_at INTEGER,
  retirement_reason TEXT CHECK(retirement_reason IS NULL OR retirement_reason = 'not_issued'),
  retirement_requested_at INTEGER,
  retirement_next_attempt_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, credential_keyset_commitment TEXT
  CHECK(credential_keyset_commitment IS NULL OR (typeof(credential_keyset_commitment) = 'text'
    AND length(CAST(credential_keyset_commitment AS BLOB)) = 64 AND length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64
    AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), saved_at INTEGER, holder_removed_at INTEGER, card_type TEXT, instance_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  CHECK (typeof(instance_epoch) = 'integer' AND instance_epoch >= 1), retirement_settled_at INTEGER,
  UNIQUE (pass_id, provider, credential_generation, channel_epoch),
  CHECK (retirement_cause IS NULL OR retirement_requested_at IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (
    (lifecycle IN ('blocked', 'ready') AND account_id IS NULL AND identity_projection_release_id IS NULL
      AND desired_operation_id IS NULL AND desired_version = 0 AND retirement_reason IS NULL
      AND retired_at IS NULL AND installation_state = 'unknown')
    OR (lifecycle = 'retired' AND account_id IS NULL AND identity_projection_release_id IS NULL
      AND desired_operation_id IS NULL AND desired_version = 0 AND retirement_reason IS NOT NULL AND retirement_reason = 'not_issued'
      AND retired_at IS NOT NULL AND installation_state = 'unknown')
    OR (lifecycle IN ('active', 'revoking', 'revoked', 'retired') AND account_id IS NOT NULL
      AND identity_projection_release_id IS NOT NULL AND desired_operation_id IS NOT NULL
      AND desired_version > 0 AND retirement_reason IS NULL)
  )
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_provider_instance_operations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('upsert', 'revoke')),
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(request_hash) = 64 AND request_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  pass_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (pass_version > 0),
  pass_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (pass_revision >= 0),
  pass_credential_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(pass_credential_generation) = 'integer' AND pass_credential_generation >= 1),
  lifecycle_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (lifecycle_generation >= 0),
  issuing_release_id TEXT REFERENCES template_releases(id),
  projection_release_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_releases(id),
  account_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (account_revision > 0),
  adapter_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (adapter_revision > 0),
  policy_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (policy_revision > 0),
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'retry', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'superseded', 'uncertain')),
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 8),
  next_attempt_at INTEGER,
  claim_hash TEXT CHECK (claim_hash IS NULL OR (length(claim_hash) = 64 AND claim_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  claim_expires_at INTEGER,
  last_attempt_at INTEGER,
  last_result_at INTEGER,
  completed_at INTEGER,
  reason_code TEXT CHECK (reason_code IS NULL OR reason_code IN
    ('ok', 'not_issued', 'rate_limited', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unauthorized', 'rejected', 'invalid_response', 'provider_error')),
  http_status INTEGER CHECK (http_status IS NULL OR http_status BETWEEN 100 AND 599),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, credential_keyset_commitment TEXT
  CHECK(credential_keyset_commitment IS NULL OR (typeof(credential_keyset_commitment) = 'text'
    AND length(CAST(credential_keyset_commitment AS BLOB)) = 64 AND length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64
    AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), credential_version_id TEXT
  REFERENCES wallet_credential_versions(id), pass_row_version INTEGER
  CHECK (pass_row_version IS NULL OR (typeof(pass_row_version) = 'integer' AND pass_row_version > 0)), account_epoch INTEGER
  CHECK (account_epoch IS NULL OR (typeof(account_epoch) = 'integer' AND account_epoch > 0)),
  UNIQUE (instance_id, version),
  UNIQUE (instance_id, request_hash),
  CHECK (kind != 'upsert' OR issuing_release_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK ((state IN ('claimed', 'uncertain') AND claim_hash IS NOT NULL AND claim_expires_at IS NOT NULL)
    OR state NOT IN ('claimed', 'uncertain'))
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_provider_offer_refs (
  ref_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(ref_hash) = 64 AND ref_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  operation_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (operation_version > 0),
  pass_authority_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(pass_authority_generation >= 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= created_at + 300000),
  consumed_at INTEGER,
  delivered_at INTEGER,
  CHECK (delivered_at IS NULL OR (consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at >= consumed_at AND delivered_at < expires_at))
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_provider_callback_events (
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_accounts(id),
  event_id_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(event_id_hash) = 64 AND event_id_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(payload_hash) = 64 AND payload_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  operation_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (operation_version > 0),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('installed', 'uninstalled', 'other')),
  observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (account_id, event_id_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_provider_instance_outcomes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instance_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt BETWEEN 1 AND 8),
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence > 0),
  event_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(event_hash) = 64 AND event_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_hash) = 64 AND payload_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  reason_code TEXT CHECK(reason_code IS NULL OR reason_code IN ('ok', 'not_issued', 'rate_limited', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unauthorized', 'rejected', 'invalid_response', 'provider_error')),
  http_status INTEGER CHECK(http_status IS NULL OR http_status BETWEEN 100 AND 599),
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL, method TEXT, stage TEXT,
  UNIQUE(operation_id, attempt, event_hash),
  UNIQUE(operation_id, attempt, sequence)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_provider_instance_dirty (
  instance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation > 0),
  next_attempt_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_samsung_fetch_refs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ref_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(ref_hash)=64 AND ref_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_offered_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  initial_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(initial_expires_at > last_offered_at AND initial_expires_at <= last_offered_at + 300000),
  promoted_at INTEGER,
  retired_at INTEGER,
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(kek_version > 0),
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL, credential_keyset_commitment TEXT
  CHECK(credential_keyset_commitment IS NULL OR (typeof(credential_keyset_commitment) = 'text'
    AND length(CAST(credential_keyset_commitment AS BLOB)) = 64 AND length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64
    AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), market_cc2 TEXT
  CHECK(market_cc2 IS NULL OR (length(market_cc2) = 2 AND market_cc2 NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*')), market_query_bound INTEGER
  CHECK(market_query_bound IS NULL OR market_query_bound IN (0, 1)), served_at INTEGER, credential_version_id TEXT
  REFERENCES wallet_credential_versions(id),
  CHECK(promoted_at IS NULL OR promoted_at >= created_at),
  CHECK(retired_at IS NULL OR retired_at >= created_at)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_samsung_callback_receipts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  ref_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_samsung_fetch_refs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_accounts(id),
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  operation_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind = 'state_callback'),
  signed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(kek_version > 0),
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL
, event TEXT
  CHECK(event IS NULL OR event IN ('ADDED', 'DELETED', 'UPDATED', 'PROVISIONED')), cc2 TEXT
  CHECK(cc2 IS NULL OR (length(cc2) = 2 AND cc2 NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*')), query_bound INTEGER
  CHECK(query_bound IS NULL OR query_bound IN (0, 1)), token_hash TEXT
  CHECK(token_hash IS NULL OR length(token_hash) = 43), request_id TEXT
  CHECK(request_id IS NULL OR length(request_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64))

CREATE TABLE wallet_samsung_country_hints (
  ref_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_samsung_fetch_refs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  country_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(country_code)=2 AND country_code NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*'),
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(ref_id, country_code)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_provider_sync_targets (
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instance_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  country_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(country_code)=2 AND country_code NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z]*'),
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending', 'inflight', 'retry', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'uncertain')),
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 3),
  next_attempt_at INTEGER,
  reason_code TEXT CHECK(reason_code IS NULL OR reason_code IN ('ok', 'rate_limited', 'unavailable', 'timeout', 'unauthorized', 'rejected', 'invalid_response', 'provider_error')),
  http_status INTEGER CHECK(http_status IS NULL OR http_status BETWEEN 100 AND 599),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, sent_state TEXT
  CHECK (sent_state IS NULL OR sent_state IN ('ACTIVE', 'UPDATED', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELED', 'DELETED')),
  PRIMARY KEY(operation_id, country_code)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_google_callback_bindings (
  instance_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_accounts(id),
  class_id_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(class_id_hash)=64 AND class_id_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  object_id_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(object_id_hash)=64 AND object_id_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, credential_keyset_commitment TEXT
  CHECK(credential_keyset_commitment IS NULL OR (typeof(credential_keyset_commitment) = 'text'
    AND length(CAST(credential_keyset_commitment AS BLOB)) = 64 AND length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64
    AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), class_type TEXT
  CHECK(class_type IS NULL OR class_type IN ('generic', 'event', 'loyalty', 'gift', 'offer')), class_key TEXT
  CHECK(class_key IS NULL OR (class_type IS NOT NULL AND length(class_key) = 64 AND class_key NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  UNIQUE(account_id, object_id_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_google_callback_receipts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_accounts(id),
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('save', 'del')),
  nonce_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(nonce_hash)=64 AND nonce_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(kek_version > 0),
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(account_id, nonce_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE channel_apply_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'running', 'done', 'dropped', 'failed')),
  from_channels TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(from_channels)),
  from_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  to_channels TEXT CHECK (to_channels IS NULL OR json_valid(to_channels)),
  to_revision INTEGER,
  replace_channels TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (json_valid(replace_channels)),
  requested_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  due_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cursor TEXT,
  counts TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(counts)),
  error_code TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  started_at INTEGER,
  finished_at INTEGER, from_blocked TEXT CHECK (from_blocked IS NULL OR json_valid(from_blocked)), to_blocked TEXT CHECK (to_blocked IS NULL OR json_valid(to_blocked)), from_rev INTEGER, to_rev INTEGER, reconcile_all INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reconcile_all IN (0, 1)),
  CHECK ((state IN ('pending', 'dropped')) = (to_channels IS NULL) OR state = 'failed')
)

CREATE TABLE channel_apply_marks (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES channel_apply_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  events TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(events)),
  journaled_at INTEGER,
  notice_at INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, pass_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE scan_offline_reads (
  id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  pass_id TEXT,
  actor_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  session_id TEXT,
  scanner_id TEXT,
  door TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (door IN ('listed', 'unverified', 'refused')),
  scan_id TEXT,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('ok', 'heads_up', 'refused')),
  reason TEXT,
  conflict INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (conflict IN (0, 1)),
  client_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
  recorded_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
  synced_at INTEGER NOT NULL, late INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (actor_key, idempotency_key)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE scan_session_changes (
  session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  prev_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  prev_mode TEXT NOT NULL, timing TEXT, prev_timing TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (session_id, at)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE scan_offline_state (
  scanner_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  online_at INTEGER NOT NULL
, roster_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE visitors (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
  host_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(host_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 80),
  host_email TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(host_email) BETWEEN 3 AND 254),
  window_from INTEGER NOT NULL,
  window_until INTEGER NOT NULL,
  note TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 100),
  left_at INTEGER,
  left_by TEXT,
  cancelled_at INTEGER,
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CHECK (window_until > window_from),
  CHECK ((left_at IS NULL) = (left_by IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE roll_calls (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  -- 'session:<id>' for a scanning session's devices, 'org' for a call over every tracked zone.
  scope_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- [{ place, name, basis }]: basis is 'in_now' where tap-out is required, else 'tapped_in'.
  places TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(places)),
  -- [{ passId, place, since }]: ids only. Names are read from the pass when the call is shown, so they go
  -- with the pass and never outlive it; the call itself leaves with the scans retention window.
  snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(snapshot)),
  started_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_by_id TEXT,
  scanner_id TEXT,
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ended_at INTEGER,
  ended_by TEXT,
  -- Raised by every mark, so a device can tell a stale copy.
  rev INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  CHECK ((ended_at IS NULL) = (ended_by IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE roll_call_marks (
  roll_call_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roll_calls (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('present', 'out', 'none')),
  by_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  scanner_id TEXT,
  -- A person who tapped in after the start (a snapshot person's shape); null for one in the snapshot.
  late TEXT CHECK (late IS NULL OR json_valid(late)),
  -- The scan that exited them when marked Out; undone if the mark is taken back.
  exit_scan_id TEXT,
  -- The device's time of the mark: the later one wins, whatever order the two arrive in.
  marked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (roll_call_id, pass_id)
)

CREATE TABLE scan_group_members (
  group_scan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  scan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  PRIMARY KEY (group_scan_id, scan_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nfc_tag_systems (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 2 AND 16 AND id NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*'),
  assurance TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (assurance IN ('basic', 'secure')),
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1))
)

CREATE TABLE nfc_tag_types (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
  system TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nfc_tag_systems (id),
  use TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(use) BETWEEN 2 AND 16 AND use NOT GLOB '*[^a-z_]*'),
  scopes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'both' CHECK (scopes IN ('pass', 'user', 'both')),
  per_pass INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (per_pass BETWEEN 1 AND 4),
  binding_days INTEGER CHECK (binding_days IS NULL OR binding_days BETWEEN 1 AND 3650),
  confirm TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (confirm IN ('none', 'staff', 'manager')),
  typed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (typed IN (0, 1)),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  archived_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE nfc_tag_type_templates (
  type_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nfc_tag_types (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  template_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates (id),
  PRIMARY KEY (type_id, template_id)
)

CREATE TABLE nfc_tags (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  tag_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(tag_ref) = 64 AND tag_ref NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  system TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nfc_tag_systems (id),
  type_id TEXT REFERENCES nfc_tag_types (id),
  hint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(hint) = 4 AND hint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-F]*' AND hint = upper(substr(tag_ref, 1, 4))),
  label TEXT CHECK (label IS NULL OR length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'retired')),
  status_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at INTEGER,
  lost_at INTEGER,
  lost_by TEXT,
  CHECK ((lost_at IS NULL) = (lost_by IS NULL)),
  UNIQUE (org_id, mode, tag_ref)
)

CREATE TABLE tag_bindings (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nfc_tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('pass', 'user')),
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('scanner', 'remote', 'admin')),
  bound_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  bound_by_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (bound_by_type IN ('user', 'staff', 'scanner')),
  bound_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  scanner_id TEXT,
  holder_generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
  holder_owner TEXT,
  ended_at INTEGER,
  ended_by_type TEXT CHECK (ended_by_type IS NULL OR ended_by_type IN ('user', 'staff', 'scanner', 'system')),
  ended_by TEXT,
  end_cause TEXT CHECK (end_cause IS NULL OR end_cause IN ('admin', 'staff', 'undo', 'lost', 'replaced', 'moved',
    'holder_changed', 'pass_deleted', 'no_passes', 'offboard', 'pass_ended', 'tag_retired',
    'visitor_out', 'channel_off', 'expired', 'type_changed')),
  idempotency_key TEXT,
  request_hash TEXT,
  cleared_lost_at INTEGER,
  cleared_lost_by TEXT,
  expires_at INTEGER CHECK (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > bound_at),
  CHECK ((scope = 'user') = (user_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK ((ended_at IS NULL) = (end_cause IS NULL) AND (ended_at IS NULL) = (ended_by_type IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE tag_enrollments (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  scanner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scanners (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  requested_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('pass', 'user')),
  -- The pass owner at request time, user scope only.
  user_id TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'done', 'cancelled', 'declined', 'expired', 'failed')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (expires_at - created_at BETWEEN 1 AND 90000),
  -- The pass's credential generation and owner when asked: completion needs them unchanged.
  holder_generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
  holder_owner TEXT,
  -- The device fetched the request and shows it.
  shown_at INTEGER,
  ended_at INTEGER,
  binding_id TEXT REFERENCES tag_bindings (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  error_code TEXT,
  CHECK ((scope = 'user') = (user_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK ((state = 'pending') = (ended_at IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE nfc_tag_keysets (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
  slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(slug) = 8 AND slug NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*'),
  diversify INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (diversify IN (0, 1)),
  -- The type tags enrolled on this keyset get by default.
  type_id TEXT REFERENCES nfc_tag_types (id),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  disabled_at INTEGER
, per_tag INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (per_tag IN (0, 1)))

CREATE TABLE nfc_tag_keys (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  keyset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nfc_tag_keysets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version BETWEEN 1 AND 255),
  -- One envelope holds the meta key and the file key (32 bytes). The file key is the master when the keyset
  -- diversifies. 12-byte iv, 32 + 16 bytes of ciphertext, a DEK wrapped by the KEK (12 + 32 + 16).
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (kek_version >= 1),
  iv BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(iv) = 12),
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(wrapped_dek) = 60),
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(ciphertext) = 48),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active', 'retiring', 'retired')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  state_at INTEGER, revoked_at INTEGER,
  UNIQUE (keyset_id, version)
)

CREATE TABLE nfc_tag_sun (
  tag_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES nfc_tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  keyset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nfc_tag_keysets (id),
  key_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (key_version BETWEEN 1 AND 255),
  -- A supplier's per-tag file key (16 bytes), sealed; all four NULL means the keyset's.
  kek_version INTEGER,
  iv BLOB,
  wrapped_dek BLOB,
  ciphertext BLOB,
  ctr INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (ctr BETWEEN 0 AND 16777215),
  ctr_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (keyset_id, key_version) REFERENCES nfc_tag_keys (keyset_id, version),
  CHECK ((kek_version IS NULL AND iv IS NULL AND wrapped_dek IS NULL AND ciphertext IS NULL)
    OR (kek_version IS NOT NULL AND iv IS NOT NULL AND wrapped_dek IS NOT NULL AND ciphertext IS NOT NULL
      AND kek_version >= 1 AND length(iv) = 12 AND length(wrapped_dek) = 60 AND length(ciphertext) = 32))
)

CREATE TABLE idempotent_requests (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  principal TEXT NOT NULL,
  operation TEXT NOT NULL,
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  status INTEGER,
  body TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, mode, principal, operation, key)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE entitlement_preset_meta (
  preset TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (preset NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9_]*' AND length(preset) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
  label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(label) BETWEEN 1 AND 60),
  is_plan INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_plan IN (0, 1)),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_by TEXT
, previous_values TEXT
  CHECK (previous_values IS NULL OR json_valid(previous_values)))

CREATE TABLE entitlement_presets (
  preset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entitlement_preset_meta (preset) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(value) AND value = json(value)),
  PRIMARY KEY (preset, key)
)

CREATE TABLE org_entitlements (
  org_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES entitlement_preset_meta (preset),
  trial_ends_at INTEGER,
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision >= 1),
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_by TEXT
, preset_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE org_entitlement_overrides (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(value) AND value = json(value)),
  note TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 200),
  expires_at INTEGER,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_by TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, key)
)

CREATE TABLE org_exports (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id),
  requested_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK (state IN ('queued', 'running', 'ready', 'failed', 'expired')),
  r2_key TEXT,
  bytes INTEGER,
  entities TEXT CHECK (entities IS NULL OR json_valid(entities)),
  error_code TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  finished_at INTEGER,
  expires_at INTEGER
, link_exp INTEGER, link_used_at INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE api_key_resources (
  key_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_keys (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('template', 'pass_style')),
  value TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(value) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  PRIMARY KEY (key_id, kind, value)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE pass_notes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  -- The holder's credential generation when written: a note belongs to the person it was written about, so a
  -- transfer deletes the pass's notes and a read never joins one of another generation.
  credential_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(credential_generation) = 'integer' AND credential_generation >= 1),
  body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 280),
  -- The writer's name when written: staff names change and staff are removed, a note keeps its author.
  author_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(author_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120),
  author_staff_id TEXT,
  scanner_id TEXT,
  -- The device's retry key: one tap sent twice is one note.
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  edited_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE developer_sandboxes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orgs (id),
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users (id),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  quickstart_viewed_at INTEGER,
  first_call_at INTEGER,
  first_pass_at INTEGER,
  first_preview_at INTEGER,
  first_live_key_at INTEGER,
  closed_at INTEGER,
  close_reason TEXT CHECK (close_reason IS NULL OR close_reason IN ('idle', 'admin', 'user')), try_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (try_generation >= 1), first_key_call_at INTEGER, first_change_at INTEGER, first_webhook_at INTEGER, track_started_at INTEGER, track_key_call_at INTEGER, track_pass_at INTEGER, track_change_at INTEGER, track_webhook_at INTEGER, terminal_id TEXT,
  CHECK ((closed_at IS NULL) = (close_reason IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE webhook_captures (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  endpoint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode = 'test'),
  event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  trigger TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trigger IN ('event', 'replay', 'test')),
  headers TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(headers)),
  body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(body AS BLOB)) <= 262144),
  status INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 200,
  duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (duration_ms >= 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (endpoint_id, org_id, mode) REFERENCES webhook_endpoints (id, org_id, mode) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE webhook_capture_hours (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  hour INTEGER NOT NULL,
  n INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (n > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, hour)
)

CREATE TABLE request_log (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id),
  key_id TEXT,
  via TEXT CHECK (via IS NULL OR via = 'try'),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  method TEXT NOT NULL,
  route TEXT,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  query TEXT,
  status INTEGER NOT NULL,
  code TEXT,
  duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  has_bodies INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (has_bodies IN (0, 1)),
  request_body TEXT,
  response_body TEXT, client TEXT CHECK (client IS NULL OR length(client) <= 32),
  CHECK (has_bodies = 1 OR (request_body IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE request_log_budget (
  org_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES orgs (id),
  hour INTEGER NOT NULL,
  hour_rows INTEGER NOT NULL,
  total_rows INTEGER NOT NULL
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE status_incidents (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  note TEXT NOT NULL,
  component TEXT CHECK (component IS NULL OR component IN ('api', 'apple_push', 'email', 'webhooks', 'google', 'samsung')),
  impact TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (impact IN ('notice', 'degraded', 'outage')),
  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  resolved_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE identity_certificates (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  identity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES signing_identities (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE,
  credential_id TEXT REFERENCES credentials (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  cert_sha256 TEXT,
  not_before INTEGER,
  not_after INTEGER,
  asc_certificate_id TEXT,
  origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('upload', 'asc', 'csr', 'env')),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'active', 'superseded', 'revoked', 'failed')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  activated_at INTEGER,
  ended_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE identity_handles (
  handle TEXT PRIMARY KEY
    CHECK (handle GLOB '[a-z]*' AND handle NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9]*' AND length(handle) BETWEEN 2 AND 30),
  org_id TEXT, -- no foreign key: the reservation survives an org purge
  reserved_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE identity_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT REFERENCES orgs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('apple', 'google', 'samsung')),
  mode TEXT CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('provision', 'rotate', 'revoke', 'adopt', 'cards')),
  target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('identity', 'wallet_credential', 'org')),
  target_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued', 'running', 'waiting', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
  step TEXT,
  attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  waiting_for TEXT,
  csr_pubkey_sha256 TEXT,
  external_ref TEXT CHECK (external_ref IS NULL OR json_valid(external_ref)),
  error_code TEXT,
  created_by TEXT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  finished_at INTEGER
, lease_until INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE wallet_org_cards (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs (id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  card_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  card_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft', 'verifying', 'active', 'rejected', 'retired')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, mode, card_type)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_sa_keys (
  key_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  credential_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_credentials (id),
  origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created' CHECK (origin IN ('created', 'adopted')),
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'active', 'retiring', 'retired')),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  deleted_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_google_issuers (
  issuer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (issuer_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND length(issuer_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('created', 'shared', 'manual')),
  claimed_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE console_email_grace (
  user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_enrolment_events (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL,
  enrolment_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(enrolment_revision) = 'integer' AND enrolment_revision > 0),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('source', 'enable', 'disable', 'hold', 'release', 'revoke')),
  credential_id TEXT REFERENCES wallet_credentials(id),
  check_id TEXT REFERENCES wallet_credential_checks(id),
  round_trip_kind TEXT CHECK (round_trip_kind IN ('google_save', 'samsung_added')),
  round_trip_id TEXT,
  reason TEXT CHECK (reason IS NULL OR length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
  actor_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('user', 'platform', 'system', 'api_key')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  request_id TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)),
  UNIQUE (account_id, enrolment_revision),
  FOREIGN KEY (account_id, org_id, mode, provider)
    REFERENCES wallet_provider_accounts(id, org_id, mode, provider),
  CHECK ((round_trip_kind IS NULL) = (round_trip_id IS NULL)),
  CHECK (kind = 'enable' OR (check_id IS NULL AND round_trip_id IS NULL)),
  CHECK (kind NOT IN ('source', 'enable') OR credential_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (kind != 'enable' OR check_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (kind != 'hold' OR reason IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (kind NOT IN ('hold', 'release') OR actor_type = 'platform'),
  CHECK (actor_type = 'system' OR actor_id IS NOT NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE pass_bulk_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('void', 'send_email', 'remove')),
  message TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued', 'running', 'done', 'stopped', 'failed')),
  total INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  skipped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  skipped_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (json_valid(skipped_by)),
  starter TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(starter)),
  stop_requested INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stop_requested IN (0, 1)),
  code TEXT,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  moved_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  finished_at INTEGER
)

CREATE TABLE pass_bulk_locks (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  moved_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, mode)
)

CREATE TABLE pass_views (
  org_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orgs(id),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('live', 'test')),
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
  items TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(items)),
  moved_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (org_id, mode)
)

CREATE TABLE broadcast_targets (
  broadcast_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES broadcasts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pass_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  intent TEXT CHECK (intent IS NULL OR json_valid(intent)), written_version INTEGER, written_prev TEXT, written_next TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (broadcast_id, pass_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE template_rollout_failures (
  pass_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  release_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  at INTEGER NOT NULL
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE wallet_google_messages (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instance_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  base_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (base_version > 0),
  target_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (target_version > base_version),
  notify INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (notify IN (0, 1)),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'sending', 'notified', 'text', 'failed', 'unknown', 'superseded')),
  reason TEXT CHECK (reason IS NULL OR reason IN ('budget', 'quota', 'refused', 'unconfirmed', 'rate_limited', 'not_sent')),
  http_status INTEGER CHECK (http_status IS NULL OR http_status BETWEEN 100 AND 599),
  tries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tries BETWEEN 0 AND 8),
  kek_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  iv BLOB NOT NULL,
  wrapped_dek BLOB NOT NULL,
  ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  settled_at INTEGER,
  UNIQUE (instance_id, base_version, target_version),
  CHECK ((state IN ('notified', 'text', 'failed', 'unknown')) = (settled_at IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_google_classes (
  class_id_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(class_id_hash) = 64 AND class_id_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  release_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  release_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(release_generation >= 0),
  body_digest TEXT CHECK(body_digest IS NULL OR (length(body_digest) = 64 AND body_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  pending_generation INTEGER CHECK(pending_generation IS NULL OR pending_generation > 0),
  pending_at INTEGER,
  written_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_google_revocation_confirmations (
  operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES wallet_provider_instance_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('inactive', 'absent')),
  outcome_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES wallet_provider_instance_outcomes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  confirmed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  credential_keyset_commitment TEXT NOT NULL
  CHECK(length(credential_keyset_commitment) = 64 AND credential_keyset_commitment NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_projection_art_files (
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_candidates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  asset TEXT NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  width INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(width > 0),
  height INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(height > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (candidate_id, asset)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_samsung_card_state (
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES template_candidates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  candidate_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  account_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL,
  card_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL,
  testing_mode_off TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (testing_mode_off IN ('Y', 'N')),
  verified_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CHECK (expires_at > verified_at AND expires_at <= verified_at + 300000)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE wallet_reissue_steps (
  reissue_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  after_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  sent_at INTEGER,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (reissue_id, after_id)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE pass_boundaries (
  pass_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES passes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  -- The artifact the row describes: its pass_versions row.
  version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  object_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- When the row is next worked out; NULL once no boundary is left.
  due_at INTEGER,
  -- When the timed keys below were worked out; 0 while devices get the artifact as built.
  rendered_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  render TEXT CHECK (render IS NULL OR json_valid(render)),
  -- The render's update tag (a revisions row) and when it was taken, for updated-since and Last-Modified.
  stamp INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stamped_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  -- Failed runs in a row; the next one waits longer.
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

CREATE VIEW template_provider_apple_sources AS
SELECT r.id, r.template_id, r.org_id, r.mode, r.version, r.generation, r.candidate_hash,
       r.content_hash, t.origin, t.org_id AS template_org_id
FROM template_releases r
JOIN templates t ON t.id = r.template_id
JOIN template_versions v ON v.template_id = r.template_id AND v.version = r.version
WHERE r.provider = 'apple' AND t.status = 'active'
  AND r.adapter_revision = 1 AND r.adapter_capabilities = '["apple-passkit"]'
  AND r.audience_policy_revision = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_releases newer
    WHERE newer.template_id = r.template_id AND newer.org_id IS r.org_id
      AND newer.mode = r.mode AND newer.provider = 'apple' AND newer.generation > r.generation)
  AND ((r.source = 'system' AND r.action = 'system' AND t.origin = 'baked'
        AND r.org_id IS t.org_id AND r.version = t.active_version
        AND r.candidate_id IS NULL AND r.approval_id IS NULL)
    OR (r.source = 'approved' AND r.action IN ('release', 'rollback') AND t.origin = 'uploaded'
        AND r.org_id IS NOT NULL AND (t.org_id IS NULL OR t.org_id = r.org_id)
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_candidates c
          JOIN template_approvals a ON a.candidate_id = c.id
          WHERE c.id = r.candidate_id AND a.id = r.approval_id
            AND c.template_id = r.template_id AND c.org_id IS r.org_id AND c.mode = r.mode
            AND c.provider = 'apple' AND c.version = r.version
            AND c.candidate_hash = r.candidate_hash AND a.candidate_hash = c.candidate_hash
            AND c.content_hash = r.content_hash AND c.adapter_revision = r.adapter_revision
            AND c.adapter_capabilities = r.adapter_capabilities
            AND c.audience_policy_revision = r.audience_policy_revision
            AND v.created_by IS c.version_author_id AND a.reviewer_id != c.author_id
            AND (c.version_author_id IS NULL OR a.reviewer_id != c.version_author_id))))

CREATE VIEW template_release_heads AS
SELECT r.template_id AS template_id, COALESCE(r.org_id, '') AS org_scope, r.mode AS mode,
  r.provider AS provider, r.id AS release_id, r.generation AS generation
FROM template_releases r
WHERE r.generation = (SELECT MAX(n.generation) FROM template_releases n
  WHERE n.template_id = r.template_id AND n.org_id IS r.org_id AND n.mode = r.mode AND n.provider = r.provider)

CREATE VIEW credential_ref_keyset_blocking_events AS
SELECT 1 AS present FROM pass_events WHERE CASE WHEN json_valid(data)
  THEN json_type(data, '$.authority.credentialKeysetCommitment') IS NOT NULL
    OR json_type(data, '$.authority.eventProof') IS NOT NULL
    OR json_type(data, '$.actionIdRef') IS NOT NULL
    OR json_extract(data, '$.authority.scannerCsrfProof') IS NOT NULL
    OR json_extract(data, '$.authority.sessionCsrfProof') IS NOT NULL
    OR (kind LIKE 'scan.%' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM json_tree(data) field
      WHERE typeof(field.key) = 'text' AND field.type IN ('text', 'object', 'array')
        AND (
          (lower(field.key) GLOB '*ref' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*refs'
            OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*reference' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*references')
          OR (lower(field.key) GLOB '*referencecode' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*hash*'
            OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*proof*' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*secret*')
          OR (lower(field.key) GLOB '*token*' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*keyset*'
            OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*signature*' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*nonce*')
          OR (lower(field.key) GLOB '*apikey*' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*privatekey*'
            OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*password*' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*passcode*')
          OR (lower(field.key) GLOB '*scancode*' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*barcode*'
            OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*serialnumber*' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*csrf*')
          OR (lower(field.key) IN ('credential', 'credentials', 'pin')
            OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*credentialvalue*' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*credentialdata*')
          OR (lower(field.key) GLOB '*staffpin' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*hmac*'
            OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*mac' OR lower(field.key) GLOB '*macs')
        )
    )) ELSE 1 END

CREATE VIEW wallet_provider_unissued_placeholder AS
SELECT i.id FROM wallet_provider_instances i
WHERE (
  i.account_id IS NULL AND i.identity_projection_release_id IS NULL
  AND i.desired_version = 0 AND i.desired_operation_id IS NULL
  AND i.retired_at IS NULL AND i.revoked_at IS NULL
) AND (
  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op WHERE op.instance_id = i.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_offer_refs o WHERE o.instance_id = i.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_fetch_refs r WHERE r.instance_id = i.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_callback_bindings b WHERE b.instance_id = i.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_callback_events e WHERE e.instance_id = i.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_callback_receipts r WHERE r.instance_id = i.id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_callback_receipts r WHERE r.instance_id = i.id)
)

CREATE VIEW wallet_provider_pinned_desired AS
SELECT i.id FROM wallet_provider_instances i
JOIN wallet_provider_instance_operations op ON op.id = i.desired_operation_id
  AND op.instance_id = i.id AND op.version = i.desired_version
JOIN template_releases projection_release ON projection_release.id = i.identity_projection_release_id
JOIN template_candidates candidate ON candidate.id = projection_release.candidate_id
JOIN template_approvals approval ON approval.id = projection_release.approval_id AND approval.candidate_id = candidate.id
JOIN credential_ref_keyset keyset ON keyset.id = 1 AND keyset.commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
WHERE (
  op.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
  AND projection_release.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
  AND candidate.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
  AND approval.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
) AND (
  projection_release.org_id = i.org_id AND projection_release.mode = i.mode
  AND projection_release.provider = i.provider AND projection_release.source = 'approved'
  AND candidate.org_id = i.org_id AND candidate.mode = i.mode AND candidate.provider = i.provider
  AND candidate.provider_account_id = i.account_id AND projection_release.candidate_hash = candidate.candidate_hash
  AND approval.candidate_hash = candidate.candidate_hash
)

CREATE VIEW org_entitlement_values AS
  SELECT e.org_id, p.key, COALESCE(o.value, p.value) AS value
  FROM org_entitlements e
  JOIN entitlement_presets p ON p.preset = e.preset
  LEFT JOIN org_entitlement_overrides o ON o.org_id = e.org_id AND o.key = p.key
    AND (o.expires_at IS NULL OR o.expires_at > CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER))

CREATE VIEW key_templates AS
SELECT key.id AS key_id, tpl.id AS id
FROM api_keys key JOIN templates tpl ON tpl.org_id = key.org_id OR (tpl.org_id IS NULL AND (tpl.shared = 1 OR tpl.origin = 'baked'))
WHERE key.restricted = 1
  AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_key_resources res WHERE res.key_id = key.id AND res.kind = 'template')
    OR tpl.id IN (SELECT res.value FROM api_key_resources res WHERE res.key_id = key.id AND res.kind = 'template'))
  AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_key_resources res WHERE res.key_id = key.id AND res.kind = 'pass_style')
    OR (json_array_length(tpl.styles) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(tpl.styles) sty
      WHERE sty.type <> 'text' OR sty.value NOT IN (SELECT res.value FROM api_key_resources res WHERE res.key_id = key.id AND res.kind = 'pass_style'))))
  AND (key.parent_key_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_keys par WHERE par.id = key.parent_key_id AND par.restricted = 0)
    OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_keys par WHERE par.id = key.parent_key_id AND par.restricted = 1)
      AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_key_resources pres WHERE pres.key_id = key.parent_key_id AND pres.kind = 'template')
        OR tpl.id IN (SELECT pres.value FROM api_key_resources pres WHERE pres.key_id = key.parent_key_id AND pres.kind = 'template'))
      AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM api_key_resources pres WHERE pres.key_id = key.parent_key_id AND pres.kind = 'pass_style')
        OR (json_array_length(tpl.styles) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(tpl.styles) psty
          WHERE psty.type <> 'text' OR psty.value NOT IN (SELECT pres.value FROM api_key_resources pres WHERE pres.key_id = key.parent_key_id AND pres.kind = 'pass_style'))))))

CREATE VIEW wallet_google_retirement_complete AS
SELECT i.id FROM wallet_provider_instances i
WHERE i.lifecycle = 'retired' AND i.provider = 'google' AND i.retirement_reason IS NULL
  AND i.retirement_requested_at IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credential_ref_keyset keyset WHERE keyset.id = 1
    AND keyset.commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_accounts a WHERE a.id = i.account_id
    AND a.org_id = i.org_id AND a.mode = i.mode AND a.provider = i.provider)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op
    JOIN wallet_google_revocation_confirmations confirmed ON confirmed.operation_id = op.id
    WHERE op.id = i.desired_operation_id AND op.instance_id = i.id AND op.version = i.desired_version
      AND op.kind = 'revoke' AND op.state = 'succeeded'
      AND op.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
      AND confirmed.instance_id = i.id AND confirmed.version = op.version
      AND confirmed.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations busy
    WHERE busy.instance_id = i.id AND busy.state IN ('pending', 'retry', 'claimed', 'uncertain'))

CREATE VIEW wallet_provider_retirement_complete_base AS
SELECT i.id FROM wallet_provider_instances i
WHERE i.lifecycle = 'retired'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credential_ref_keyset keyset WHERE keyset.id = 1
    AND keyset.commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment)
  AND (
  (i.retirement_reason = 'not_issued' AND i.account_id IS NULL AND i.identity_projection_release_id IS NULL
    AND i.desired_version = 0 AND i.desired_operation_id IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op WHERE op.instance_id = i.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_offer_refs o WHERE o.instance_id = i.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_fetch_refs r WHERE r.instance_id = i.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_callback_bindings b WHERE b.instance_id = i.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_callback_events e WHERE e.instance_id = i.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_callback_receipts r WHERE r.instance_id = i.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_callback_receipts r WHERE r.instance_id = i.id))
  OR (i.provider = 'samsung' AND i.retirement_reason IS NULL AND i.retirement_requested_at IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_accounts a WHERE a.id = i.account_id
      AND a.org_id = i.org_id AND a.mode = i.mode AND a.provider = i.provider)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_releases projection_release
      JOIN template_candidates candidate ON candidate.id = projection_release.candidate_id
      JOIN template_approvals approval ON approval.id = projection_release.approval_id AND approval.candidate_id = candidate.id
      LEFT JOIN wallet_provider_projection_evidence_history evidence ON evidence.candidate_id = candidate.id
      WHERE (
        projection_release.id = i.identity_projection_release_id AND projection_release.org_id = i.org_id
        AND projection_release.mode = i.mode AND projection_release.provider = 'samsung' AND projection_release.source = 'approved'
        AND candidate.provider_account_id = i.account_id
        AND candidate.org_id = i.org_id AND candidate.mode = i.mode AND candidate.provider = 'samsung'
      ) AND (
        projection_release.candidate_hash = candidate.candidate_hash AND approval.candidate_hash = candidate.candidate_hash
        AND approval.reviewer_id != candidate.author_id
        AND (candidate.version_author_id IS NULL OR approval.reviewer_id != candidate.version_author_id)
        AND projection_release.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
        AND candidate.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
        AND approval.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
      ) AND (json_extract(candidate.projection_json, '$.schema') = 2 OR (
        evidence.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
        AND evidence.org_id = i.org_id AND evidence.mode = i.mode AND evidence.account_id = i.account_id
        AND evidence.account_revision = candidate.provider_account_revision AND evidence.candidate_hash = candidate.candidate_hash
        AND evidence.provider_identity_hash = candidate.provider_identity_hash
        AND evidence.card_type = json_extract(candidate.projection_json, '$.cardType')
        AND evidence.card_sub_type = json_extract(candidate.projection_json, '$.cardSubType')
        AND evidence.country_code = json_extract(candidate.projection_json, '$.countryCode')
        AND evidence.testing_mode_off = 'Y' AND evidence.verified_at <= projection_release.created_at
        AND projection_release.created_at < evidence.expires_at
      )))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op
      WHERE op.id = i.desired_operation_id AND op.instance_id = i.id AND op.version = i.desired_version
        AND op.kind = 'revoke' AND op.state = 'succeeded'
        AND op.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations busy
      WHERE busy.instance_id = i.id AND busy.state IN ('pending', 'retry', 'claimed', 'uncertain'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_fetch_refs ref WHERE ref.instance_id = i.id
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_tombstones t
        JOIN template_releases r ON r.id = i.identity_projection_release_id
        JOIN template_candidates c ON c.id = r.candidate_id
        WHERE (
          ref.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
          AND t.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
          AND t.ref_hash = ref.ref_hash AND t.org_id = i.org_id AND t.mode = i.mode
          AND t.account_id = i.account_id AND t.release_id = r.id AND t.candidate_id = c.id
        ) AND (
          r.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
          AND c.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
          AND c.provider_account_id = i.account_id AND t.account_revision = c.provider_account_revision
          AND t.provider_identity_hash = c.provider_identity_hash
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

CREATE TRIGGER template_versions_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE ON template_versions
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'template versions are immutable');
END

CREATE TRIGGER registrations_cap
BEFORE INSERT ON registrations
WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM registrations WHERE pass_id = NEW.pass_id) >= 20
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'registration cap reached');
END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_created
AFTER INSERT ON passes
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO revisions (pass_id, at) VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.modified_at);
  UPDATE passes
    SET revision = last_insert_rowid(), pending_pass_json = NULL, pending_cause = 'admin',
        pending_actor_type = NULL, pending_actor_id = NULL, pending_source = NULL
    WHERE id = NEW.id;
  INSERT INTO pass_versions (pass_id, version, object_key, object_sha256, template_version,
                             personalization, pass_json, cause, source, actor_type, actor_id, created_at)
    VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.version, NEW.object_key, NEW.object_sha256, NEW.template_version,
            NEW.personalization, NEW.pending_pass_json,
            'create', NEW.pending_source,
            NEW.pending_actor_type, NEW.pending_actor_id, NEW.modified_at);
END

CREATE TRIGGER sandbox_forwards_insert_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON sandbox_forwards
WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM sandbox_forwards f
  WHERE f.id = NEW.id OR (f.capture_id = NEW.capture_id AND f.state IN ('sending', 'unknown'))
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(IGNORE);
END

CREATE TRIGGER sandbox_forwards_add_passes
AFTER INSERT ON sandbox_forwards
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid forwarding reservation')
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.pass_ids) WHERE type != 'text')
      OR (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(NEW.pass_ids))
        != (SELECT count(DISTINCT value) FROM json_each(NEW.pass_ids));
  INSERT INTO sandbox_forward_passes (forward_id, pass_id)
    SELECT NEW.id, value FROM json_each(NEW.pass_ids);
END

CREATE TRIGGER sandbox_forwards_update_guard
BEFORE UPDATE ON sandbox_forwards
WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id
  OR (OLD.capture_id IS NOT NEW.capture_id AND (
    OLD.state IN ('sending', 'unknown')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM captured_emails c WHERE c.id = OLD.capture_id)
  ))
  OR (OLD.email IS NOT NEW.email AND (
    OLD.state IN ('sending', 'unknown')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_emails e WHERE e.email = OLD.email)
  ))
  OR OLD.intent IS NOT NEW.intent
  OR OLD.pass_ids IS NOT NEW.pass_ids
  OR OLD.created_at IS NOT NEW.created_at
  OR (OLD.state IN ('sending', 'unknown') AND (
    OLD.org_id IS NOT NEW.org_id OR OLD.bundle_id IS NOT NEW.bundle_id
    OR OLD.actor_id IS NOT NEW.actor_id
  ))
  OR OLD.lease_until IS NOT NEW.lease_until
  OR (OLD.state IS NOT NEW.state AND NOT (
    (OLD.state = 'sending' AND NEW.state IN ('sent', 'failed', 'unknown', 'expired'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'unknown' AND NEW.state = 'expired')
  ))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'forwarding reservation is locked');
END

      AND prior.event_id=later.event_id AND prior.sequence<later.sequence

CREATE TRIGGER scan_retention_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON scan_retention_proofs
