    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_retention_proofs WHERE ledger_event_id = NEW.ledger_event_id)
    OR NEW.excluded <> 0 OR NEW.invalidated <> 0 OR NEW.occupancy_invalidated <> 0
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_quarantine_exclusions WHERE scan_id = NEW.scan_id)
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM scans s
      JOIN passes p ON p.id = s.pass_id AND p.org_id = s.org_id AND p.mode = s.mode
      JOIN pass_events e ON e.id = NEW.ledger_event_id AND e.pass_id = p.id
        AND e.org_id = s.org_id AND e.mode = s.mode
      WHERE s.id = NEW.scan_id AND s.org_id = NEW.org_id AND s.mode = NEW.mode
        AND s.state = 'done' AND p.test_data_quarantined = 0
        AND (CASE WHEN json_valid(e.data) THEN json_extract(e.data,'$.scanId') END) = s.id
        AND (SELECT count(*) FROM pass_events x WHERE x.pass_id=e.pass_id AND x.org_id=e.org_id
          AND x.mode=e.mode AND (CASE WHEN json_valid(x.data) THEN json_extract(x.data,'$.scanId') END) = s.id) = 1
    ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid scan retention source') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER scan_retention_capture_gates BEFORE DELETE ON passes
WHEN OLD.test_data_quarantined = 0
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO scan_retained_gates (scan_id, org_id, mode, event_id, pass_ref, state, presence_state)
  SELECT s.id, s.org_id, s.mode, s.event_id, intent.pass_ref,
    COALESCE(presence.state, g.state), COALESCE(presence.state, g.state)
  FROM scan_retention_delete_intents intent
  JOIN scans anchor ON anchor.id = intent.scan_id AND anchor.pass_id = OLD.id
    AND anchor.org_id = OLD.org_id AND anchor.mode = OLD.mode
  JOIN scan_gates g ON g.pass_id = OLD.id AND g.org_id = OLD.org_id AND g.mode = OLD.mode
  JOIN scans s ON s.id = g.last_scan_id AND s.pass_id = OLD.id AND s.org_id = g.org_id
    AND s.mode = g.mode AND s.template_id = g.template_id AND s.action_id = g.action_id
  JOIN scan_retention_proofs proof ON proof.scan_id = s.id AND proof.org_id = s.org_id
    AND proof.mode = s.mode AND proof.pass_ref = intent.pass_ref
    AND proof.excluded = 0 AND proof.invalidated = 0 AND proof.occupancy_invalidated = 0
  JOIN scan_retention_event_transitions committed ON committed.scan_id=s.id
    AND committed.org_id=s.org_id AND committed.mode=s.mode AND committed.event_id=s.event_id
    AND committed.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref
  LEFT JOIN scan_presence presence ON presence.pass_id = g.pass_id AND presence.scope = 'event:' || s.event_id
  WHERE intent.org_id = OLD.org_id AND intent.mode = OLD.mode
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_quarantine_exclusions q WHERE q.scan_id = s.id)
    AND s.event_id IS NOT NULL AND (
      g.scope = 'event:' || s.event_id OR (proof.presence_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND (
        g.scope = '' OR (length(g.scope) = 14
          AND g.scope GLOB 'day:[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'))))
    AND g.kind = 'check_in' AND g.state IN ('in', 'out') AND proof.gate_snapshot IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_retention_event_transitions later
      LEFT JOIN scans later_scan ON later_scan.id=later.scan_id
      WHERE later.org_id=committed.org_id AND later.mode=committed.mode
        AND later.event_id=committed.event_id AND later.sequence>committed.sequence
        AND (later.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref OR (later.pass_ref IS NULL AND later_scan.pass_id=OLD.id))
        AND later_scan.action_kind IS NOT 'undo' AND later_scan.undone_by IS NULL)
    AND g.scope IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.scope')
    AND g.kind IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.kind')
    AND g.state IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.state')
    AND g.count IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.count')
    AND g.first_at IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.firstAt')
    AND g.last_at IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.lastAt')
    AND g.last_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.lastScanId')
    AND g.prev_state IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.prevState')
    AND g.prev_last_at IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.prevLastAt')
    AND g.prev_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot, '$.prevScanId')
    AND ((proof.presence_snapshot IS NULL AND presence.pass_id IS NULL)
      OR (proof.presence_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND presence.pass_id IS NOT NULL
        AND presence.org_id = g.org_id
        AND presence.scope IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.scope')
        AND presence.state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.state')
        AND presence.tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.tracking')
        AND presence.entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.enteredAt')
        AND presence.first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.firstAt')
        AND presence.last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.lastEntryAt')
        AND presence.last_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.lastScanId')
        AND presence.prev_state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.prevState')
        AND presence.prev_tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.prevTracking')
        AND presence.prev_entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.prevEnteredAt')
        AND presence.prev_first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.prevFirstAt')
        AND presence.prev_last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.prevLastEntryAt')
        AND presence.prev_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot, '$.prevScanId')));

  -- If a shared gate has since moved to another event, match the current
  -- event-scoped presence to its own latest signed admission/undo instead.
  INSERT INTO scan_retained_gates (scan_id, org_id, mode, event_id, pass_ref, state, presence_state)
  SELECT s.id, s.org_id, s.mode, s.event_id, intent.pass_ref, presence.state, presence.state
  FROM scan_retention_delete_intents intent
  JOIN scans anchor ON anchor.id=intent.scan_id AND anchor.pass_id=OLD.id
    AND anchor.org_id=OLD.org_id AND anchor.mode=OLD.mode
  JOIN scan_presence presence ON presence.pass_id=OLD.id AND presence.org_id=OLD.org_id
  JOIN scans s ON s.pass_id=OLD.id AND s.org_id=OLD.org_id AND s.mode=OLD.mode
    AND s.event_id IS NOT NULL AND presence.scope='event:' || s.event_id
    AND s.state='done' AND s.outcome='ok' AND s.action_kind IN ('check_in','undo')
  JOIN scan_retention_proofs proof ON proof.scan_id=s.id AND proof.org_id=s.org_id
    AND proof.mode=s.mode AND proof.pass_ref=intent.pass_ref
    AND proof.excluded=0 AND proof.invalidated=0 AND proof.occupancy_invalidated=0
  JOIN scan_retention_event_transitions committed ON committed.scan_id=s.id
    AND committed.org_id=s.org_id AND committed.mode=s.mode AND committed.event_id=s.event_id
    AND committed.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref
  WHERE intent.org_id=OLD.org_id AND intent.mode=OLD.mode
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_quarantine_exclusions q WHERE q.scan_id=s.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_retained_gates retained WHERE retained.scan_id=s.id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_retention_event_transitions later
      LEFT JOIN scans later_scan ON later_scan.id=later.scan_id
      WHERE later.org_id=committed.org_id AND later.mode=committed.mode
        AND later.event_id=committed.event_id AND later.sequence>committed.sequence
        AND (later.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref OR (later.pass_ref IS NULL AND later_scan.pass_id=OLD.id))
        AND later_scan.action_kind IS NOT 'undo' AND later_scan.undone_by IS NULL)
    AND proof.gate_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND proof.presence_snapshot IS NOT NULL
    AND json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.kind')='check_in'
    AND json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.lastScanId')=s.id
    AND presence.scope IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.scope')
    AND presence.state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.state')
    AND presence.tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.tracking')
    AND presence.entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.enteredAt')
    AND presence.first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.firstAt')
    AND presence.last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.lastEntryAt')
    AND presence.last_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.lastScanId')
    AND presence.prev_state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevState')
    AND presence.prev_tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevTracking')
    AND presence.prev_entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevEnteredAt')
    AND presence.prev_first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevFirstAt')
    AND presence.prev_last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevLastEntryAt')
    AND presence.prev_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevScanId');
END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_credential_generation_reserved

CREATE TRIGGER pass_credential_transfer_pending_pass_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF id, org_id, mode, credential_generation, lifecycle_generation, link_generation,
  status, removed_at, deleted_at, test_data_quarantined, download_token,
  template_id, template_version, release_id, connection_id, external_ref, web_service_url,

  personalization, field_sources, display_title, display_subtitle, version, object_key, object_sha256,
  object_size, content_hash, modified_at, modified_collision, removal_message, removal_prior_status,
  removal_published_generation, removal_claim_version, removal_claim_status, removal_claim_object_key,
  removal_claim_link_generation ON passes
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t WHERE t.pass_id = OLD.id AND t.state = 'pending'
  AND (
    NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
    OR NEW.lifecycle_generation IS NOT OLD.lifecycle_generation
    OR NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status OR NEW.removed_at IS NOT OLD.removed_at
    OR NEW.deleted_at IS NOT OLD.deleted_at OR NEW.test_data_quarantined IS NOT OLD.test_data_quarantined
    OR NEW.template_id IS NOT OLD.template_id OR NEW.connection_id IS NOT OLD.connection_id
    OR NEW.external_ref IS NOT OLD.external_ref OR NEW.web_service_url IS NOT OLD.web_service_url
    OR NEW.removal_message IS NOT OLD.removal_message OR NEW.removal_prior_status IS NOT OLD.removal_prior_status
    OR NEW.removal_claim_version IS NOT OLD.removal_claim_version
    OR NEW.removal_claim_status IS NOT OLD.removal_claim_status
    OR NEW.removal_claim_object_key IS NOT OLD.removal_claim_object_key
    OR NEW.removal_claim_link_generation IS NOT OLD.removal_claim_link_generation
    OR ((NEW.credential_generation IS NOT OLD.credential_generation
      OR NEW.link_generation IS NOT OLD.link_generation OR NEW.download_token IS NOT OLD.download_token)
      AND NOT (OLD.credential_generation = t.source_generation AND NEW.credential_generation = t.target_generation
        AND OLD.row_version = t.source_row_version
        AND OLD.lifecycle_generation = t.source_lifecycle_generation
        AND OLD.link_generation + 1 = t.source_link_generation AND NEW.link_generation = t.source_link_generation
        AND NEW.download_token IS NOT OLD.download_token))
    OR ((NEW.holder_email IS NOT OLD.holder_email OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT OLD.owner_user_id
      OR NEW.identity_id IS NOT OLD.identity_id OR NEW.serial IS NOT OLD.serial
      OR NEW.auth_token IS NOT OLD.auth_token OR NEW.scan_code IS NOT OLD.scan_code
      OR NEW.barcode_hash IS NOT OLD.barcode_hash OR NEW.lookup_hash IS NOT OLD.lookup_hash
      OR NEW.template_version IS NOT OLD.template_version OR NEW.release_id IS NOT OLD.release_id
      OR NEW.personalization IS NOT OLD.personalization OR NEW.field_sources IS NOT OLD.field_sources
      OR NEW.display_title IS NOT OLD.display_title OR NEW.display_subtitle IS NOT OLD.display_subtitle
      OR NEW.version IS NOT OLD.version OR NEW.object_key IS NOT OLD.object_key
      OR NEW.object_sha256 IS NOT OLD.object_sha256 OR NEW.object_size IS NOT OLD.object_size
      OR NEW.content_hash IS NOT OLD.content_hash OR NEW.modified_at IS NOT OLD.modified_at
      OR NEW.modified_collision IS NOT OLD.modified_collision
      OR NEW.removal_published_generation IS NOT OLD.removal_published_generation)
      AND NOT (OLD.credential_generation = t.target_generation
        AND OLD.lifecycle_generation = t.source_lifecycle_generation
        AND OLD.link_generation = t.source_link_generation AND NEW.version = OLD.version + 1
        AND NEW.holder_email IS t.target_holder_email AND NEW.owner_user_id IS t.target_owner_user_id
        AND NEW.serial IS NOT OLD.serial AND NEW.auth_token IS NOT OLD.auth_token
        AND NEW.scan_code IS NOT NULL AND NEW.scan_code IS NOT OLD.scan_code
        AND NEW.object_key IS NOT OLD.object_key))
  ))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'pending credential transfer is locked'); END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_issuance_delivery_target_once
BEFORE UPDATE OF target_object_key ON pass_issuance_deliveries
WHEN OLD.target_object_key IS NOT NULL OR NEW.target_object_key IS NULL
  OR NEW.transfer_id IS NULL OR NEW.state != 'pending'
  OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t JOIN passes p ON p.id = t.pass_id
    WHERE t.id = NEW.transfer_id AND t.pass_id = NEW.pass_id AND t.state = 'completed'
      AND p.object_key = NEW.target_object_key)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'issuance delivery target is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_issuance_delivery_clear_finished
AFTER UPDATE OF state ON outbox
WHEN NEW.kind = 'email' AND NEW.state IN ('sent', 'partial', 'failed', 'cancelled')
  AND NEW.error_code IS NOT 'TRANSFER_SUPERSEDED'
BEGIN
  UPDATE pass_issuance_deliveries SET outcome = NEW.state,
    error_code = CASE WHEN NEW.state = 'sent' THEN NULL ELSE NEW.error_code END
  WHERE outbox_id = NEW.id AND state = 'queued';
END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_published
AFTER UPDATE OF object_key ON passes
WHEN NEW.object_key != OLD.object_key
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO revisions (pass_id, at) VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.modified_at);
  UPDATE passes
    SET revision = last_insert_rowid(), pending_pass_json = NULL, pending_cause = 'admin',
        pending_actor_type = NULL, pending_actor_id = NULL, pending_source = NULL
    WHERE id = NEW.id;
  INSERT INTO pass_versions (pass_id, version, object_key, object_sha256, template_version,
                             personalization, pass_json, cause, source, actor_type, actor_id, created_at)
    VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.version, NEW.object_key, NEW.object_sha256, NEW.template_version,
            NEW.personalization, NEW.pending_pass_json, NEW.pending_cause, NEW.pending_source,
            NEW.pending_actor_type, NEW.pending_actor_id, NEW.modified_at);
  -- g is the lifecycle generation after pass_lifecycle_authority_changed (0042) runs on the same
  -- UPDATE: NEW holds the pre-bump value whichever trigger fires first. Keep its WHEN in step.
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO outbox
    (id, org_id, kind, pass_id, coalesce_key, payload, state, available_at, created_at)
    SELECT 'push:' || NEW.id || ':' || NEW.version, NEW.org_id, 'push', NEW.id,
      'push:' || json_array(NEW.id, NEW.identity_id, NEW.credential_generation, v.g,
        NEW.template_id, NEW.template_version, NEW.release_id),
      json_object('reason', 'publish', 'identityId', NEW.identity_id,
        'credentialGeneration', NEW.credential_generation, 'lifecycleGeneration', v.g,
        'templateId', NEW.template_id, 'templateVersion', NEW.template_version, 'releaseId', NEW.release_id),
      'pending', 0, NEW.modified_at
    FROM (SELECT NEW.lifecycle_generation + CASE
        WHEN NEW.lifecycle_generation = OLD.lifecycle_generation
          AND (NEW.deleted_at IS NOT OLD.deleted_at
            OR NEW.test_data_quarantined IS NOT OLD.test_data_quarantined
            OR NEW.removed_at IS NOT OLD.removed_at
            OR (NEW.status IS NOT OLD.status AND NEW.removed_at IS NULL))
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS g) v
    WHERE NEW.pending_cause != 'resign';
END

CREATE TRIGGER sessions_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON sessions
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions WHERE id_hash = NEW.id_hash)
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'UNIQUE constraint failed: sessions.id_hash') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retired_session_ids WHERE id_hash = NEW.id_hash)
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'session ID is retired') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER scanners_revision_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON scanners
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scanners WHERE id = NEW.id)
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'UNIQUE constraint failed: scanners.id') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retired_scanner_ids WHERE id = NEW.id)
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'scanner ID is retired') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.token_prefix IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM scanners WHERE token_prefix = NEW.token_prefix)
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'UNIQUE constraint failed: scanners.token_prefix') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.pair_code_hash IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM scanners WHERE pair_code_hash = NEW.pair_code_hash)
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'UNIQUE constraint failed: scanners.pair_code_hash') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.revoked_at IS NULL AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM scanners WHERE org_id = NEW.org_id AND mode = NEW.mode
      AND name = NEW.name COLLATE NOCASE AND revoked_at IS NULL)
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'UNIQUE constraint failed: scanners.org_id, scanners.mode, scanners.name') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_transfer_asset_uploads_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON pass_transfer_asset_uploads
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_transfer_asset_gc gc WHERE gc.r2_key = NEW.r2_key)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_transfer_asset_uploads u WHERE u.r2_key = NEW.r2_key)
  OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM passes p WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id
    AND p.credential_generation = NEW.credential_generation
    AND p.lifecycle_generation = NEW.lifecycle_generation AND p.link_generation = NEW.link_generation
    AND p.version = NEW.pass_version AND p.revision = NEW.pass_revision
    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.test_data_quarantined = 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t WHERE t.pass_id = p.id AND t.state = 'pending'))
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_assets a WHERE a.r2_key = NEW.r2_key)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_photos m WHERE m.r2_key = NEW.r2_key)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_transfer_asset_candidates c WHERE c.r2_key = NEW.r2_key)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM passes p WHERE p.object_key = NEW.r2_key)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_versions v WHERE v.object_key = NEW.r2_key)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_imports i WHERE i.object_key = NEW.r2_key)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_version_extras e WHERE e.r2_key = NEW.r2_key)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_versions v, json_tree(v.assets) j
    WHERE j.key = 'key' AND j.type = 'text' AND j.value = NEW.r2_key)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_issuance_deliveries i
    WHERE i.source_object_key = NEW.r2_key OR i.target_object_key = NEW.r2_key)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'image upload key unavailable'); END

     source_version,source_revision,source_image_generation,prior_row,next_row,created_at)

    json_array(NEW.pass_id,NEW.name,NEW.r2_key,NEW.sha1,NEW.size,NEW.width,NEW.height,NEW.crc32,NEW.created_at),
    CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 FROM passes p WHERE p.id = OLD.pass_id

CREATE TRIGGER pass_credential_transfer_insert_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON pass_credential_transfers
WHEN NEW.state != 'pending' OR NEW.completed_at IS NOT NULL
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t
    WHERE t.id = NEW.id OR (t.pass_id = NEW.pass_id
      AND (t.state = 'pending' OR t.target_generation = NEW.target_generation)))
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM passes p WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id AND p.org_id = NEW.org_id AND p.mode = NEW.mode
      AND p.test_data_quarantined = 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orgs org WHERE org.id = p.org_id AND org.status = 'active')
      AND p.credential_generation = NEW.source_generation AND p.row_version = NEW.source_row_version
      AND p.lifecycle_generation = NEW.source_lifecycle_generation
      AND p.link_generation + 1 = NEW.source_link_generation
  )
  OR (NEW.source_connection_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM passes p
    JOIN connections c ON c.id = p.connection_id AND c.org_id = p.org_id
    JOIN templates template ON template.id = p.template_id
    JOIN template_releases rel ON rel.id = NEW.source_admitted_release_id
    WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id AND p.org_id = NEW.org_id AND p.mode = 'live'
      AND p.connection_id = NEW.source_connection_id AND p.external_ref IS NEW.source_connection_ref
      AND c.enabled = 1 AND c.generation = NEW.source_connection_generation AND c.mode = NEW.source_connection_mode
      AND template.status != 'deleted'
      AND rel.template_id = p.template_id AND rel.mode = p.mode AND rel.provider = 'apple'
      AND rel.generation = NEW.source_admitted_release_generation
      AND rel.version = NEW.source_admitted_release_version
      AND (rel.org_id = p.org_id OR (rel.org_id IS NULL
        AND template.org_id IS NULL AND template.origin = 'baked'))
      AND (rel.id = p.release_id OR (template.status = 'active'
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_releases newer WHERE newer.template_id = rel.template_id
          AND newer.org_id IS rel.org_id AND newer.mode = rel.mode AND newer.provider = rel.provider
          AND newer.generation > rel.generation)))
  ))

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_pass_authority_changed
AFTER UPDATE OF download_token, owner_user_id, holder_email, link_generation ON passes
WHEN (OLD.download_token IS NOT NEW.download_token AND NOT ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM token_remac_marks m WHERE m.pass_id = OLD.id AND m.kind = 'download' AND m.mac = NEW.download_token))
    AND NEW.download_token_rotated_at IS OLD.download_token_rotated_at AND NEW.link_generation IS OLD.link_generation)) OR OLD.owner_user_id IS NOT NEW.owner_user_id
  OR OLD.holder_email IS NOT NEW.holder_email OR OLD.link_generation IS NOT NEW.link_generation
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO wallet_provider_pass_authority(pass_id, generation) VALUES (NEW.id, 1)
  ON CONFLICT(pass_id) DO UPDATE SET generation = generation + 1;
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_dirty_pass
AFTER UPDATE OF version, revision, lifecycle_generation, status, deleted_at, removed_at, release_id,
  org_id, mode, download_token, owner_user_id, holder_email, link_generation ON passes
WHEN OLD.version IS NOT NEW.version OR OLD.revision IS NOT NEW.revision
  OR OLD.lifecycle_generation IS NOT NEW.lifecycle_generation OR OLD.status IS NOT NEW.status
  OR OLD.deleted_at IS NOT NEW.deleted_at OR OLD.removed_at IS NOT NEW.removed_at
  OR OLD.release_id IS NOT NEW.release_id OR OLD.org_id IS NOT NEW.org_id OR OLD.mode IS NOT NEW.mode
  OR (OLD.download_token IS NOT NEW.download_token AND NOT ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM token_remac_marks m WHERE m.pass_id = OLD.id AND m.kind = 'download' AND m.mac = NEW.download_token))
    AND NEW.download_token_rotated_at IS OLD.download_token_rotated_at AND NEW.link_generation IS OLD.link_generation)) OR OLD.owner_user_id IS NOT NEW.owner_user_id
  OR OLD.holder_email IS NOT NEW.holder_email OR OLD.link_generation IS NOT NEW.link_generation
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO wallet_provider_instance_dirty(instance_id, generation)
  SELECT id, 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances WHERE pass_id = NEW.id
  ON CONFLICT(instance_id) DO UPDATE SET generation = generation + 1, next_attempt_at = 0;
END

CREATE TRIGGER signing_identity_revision_credential_update AFTER UPDATE OF
  org_id, kind, kek_version, iv, wrapped_dek, ciphertext, fingerprint
ON credentials
WHEN (OLD.org_id IS NOT NEW.org_id OR OLD.kind IS NOT NEW.kind
  OR OLD.kek_version IS NOT NEW.kek_version OR OLD.iv IS NOT NEW.iv
  OR OLD.wrapped_dek IS NOT NEW.wrapped_dek OR OLD.ciphertext IS NOT NEW.ciphertext
  OR OLD.fingerprint IS NOT NEW.fingerprint)
  AND NOT (NEW.kek_version > OLD.kek_version AND NEW.wrapped_dek IS NOT OLD.wrapped_dek
    AND NEW.iv IS OLD.iv AND NEW.ciphertext IS OLD.ciphertext AND NEW.org_id IS OLD.org_id
    AND NEW.kind IS OLD.kind AND NEW.fingerprint IS OLD.fingerprint)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM signing_identities WHERE credential_id = NEW.id)
BEGIN
  UPDATE signing_identity_revision_sequence SET revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = 1;
  UPDATE signing_identities SET revision = (SELECT revision FROM signing_identity_revision_sequence WHERE id = 1)
    WHERE credential_id = NEW.id;
END

CREATE TRIGGER scan_presence_seq_insert AFTER INSERT ON scan_presence
BEGIN
  UPDATE scan_presence SET
    mode = (SELECT p.mode FROM passes p WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id),
    seq = (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(x.seq), 0) + 1 FROM scan_presence x WHERE x.pass_id = NEW.pass_id)
  WHERE pass_id = NEW.pass_id AND scope = NEW.scope;
END

CREATE TRIGGER scan_presence_seq_update AFTER UPDATE OF last_scan_id ON scan_presence
WHEN NEW.last_scan_id IS NOT OLD.last_scan_id AND NEW.prev_scan_id IS OLD.last_scan_id
BEGIN
  UPDATE scan_presence SET
    prev_seq = OLD.seq,
    seq = (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(x.seq), 0) + 1 FROM scan_presence x WHERE x.pass_id = NEW.pass_id)
  WHERE pass_id = NEW.pass_id AND scope = NEW.scope;
END

CREATE TRIGGER passes_tag_bindings_follow AFTER UPDATE OF holder_email, owner_user_id, deleted_at, org_id, mode ON passes
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tag_bindings b WHERE b.pass_id = NEW.id AND b.ended_at IS NULL)
BEGIN
  UPDATE tag_bindings SET ended_at = CAST(unixepoch('now', 'subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER), ended_by_type = 'system',
    ended_by = 'passes', end_cause = CASE WHEN NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'pass_deleted' ELSE 'holder_changed' END
  WHERE pass_id = NEW.id AND scope = 'pass' AND ended_at IS NULL
    AND (NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
      OR NEW.holder_email IS NOT OLD.holder_email
      OR (OLD.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT OLD.owner_user_id));
  UPDATE tag_bindings SET pass_id = (
    SELECT p2.id FROM passes p2 JOIN nfc_tags t ON t.id = tag_bindings.tag_id
    WHERE p2.owner_user_id = tag_bindings.user_id AND p2.org_id = t.org_id AND p2.mode = t.mode
      AND p2.deleted_at IS NULL AND p2.id <> NEW.id ORDER BY p2.created_at, p2.id LIMIT 1)
  WHERE pass_id = NEW.id AND scope = 'user' AND ended_at IS NULL
    AND (NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
      OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT tag_bindings.user_id)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM passes p2 JOIN nfc_tags t ON t.id = tag_bindings.tag_id
      WHERE p2.owner_user_id = tag_bindings.user_id AND p2.org_id = t.org_id AND p2.mode = t.mode
        AND p2.deleted_at IS NULL AND p2.id <> NEW.id);
  UPDATE tag_bindings SET ended_at = CAST(unixepoch('now', 'subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER), ended_by_type = 'system',
    ended_by = 'passes', end_cause = 'no_passes'
  WHERE pass_id = NEW.id AND scope = 'user' AND ended_at IS NULL
    AND (NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
      OR NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT tag_bindings.user_id);
END

CREATE TRIGGER template_releases_insert BEFORE INSERT ON template_releases
WHEN NEW.provider = 'apple'
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.generation != COALESCE((
    SELECT MAX(r.generation) FROM template_releases r
    WHERE r.template_id = NEW.template_id AND r.org_id IS NEW.org_id
      AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider
  ), 0) + 1 OR NEW.previous_release_id IS NOT (
    SELECT r.id FROM template_releases r
    WHERE r.template_id = NEW.template_id AND r.org_id IS NEW.org_id
      AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider ORDER BY r.generation DESC LIMIT 1
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'stale template release') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM templates t WHERE t.id = NEW.template_id
      AND ((NEW.source = 'system' AND t.origin = 'baked' AND t.org_id IS NEW.org_id
          AND t.status = 'active' AND t.active_version = NEW.version)
        -- Cutover amendment: a legacy release pins the template's current active version.
        OR (NEW.source = 'legacy' AND t.origin = 'uploaded' AND NEW.org_id IS NOT NULL
          AND (t.org_id IS NULL OR t.org_id = NEW.org_id)
          AND t.status = 'active' AND t.active_version = NEW.version)
        OR (NEW.source = 'approved' AND t.origin = 'uploaded' AND NEW.org_id IS NOT NULL
          AND (t.org_id IS NULL OR t.org_id = NEW.org_id)
          AND (t.status = 'active' OR (t.status = 'archived' AND NEW.mode = 'live' AND t.org_id = NEW.org_id))))
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid template release scope') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source = 'legacy' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM template_releases r WHERE r.template_id = NEW.template_id AND r.org_id IS NEW.org_id
      AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'legacy release requires an empty scope') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source = 'approved' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM template_candidates c JOIN template_approvals a ON a.candidate_id = c.id
    WHERE c.id = NEW.candidate_id AND a.id = NEW.approval_id
      AND c.template_id = NEW.template_id AND c.org_id IS NEW.org_id
      AND c.mode = NEW.mode AND c.provider = NEW.provider AND c.version = NEW.version
      AND c.candidate_hash = NEW.candidate_hash AND a.candidate_hash = c.candidate_hash
      AND c.content_hash = NEW.content_hash AND c.adapter_revision = NEW.adapter_revision
      AND c.adapter_capabilities = NEW.adapter_capabilities
      AND c.audience_policy_revision = NEW.audience_policy_revision
      AND (NEW.action != 'release' OR a.kind != 'sole' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org_memberships m
        WHERE m.org_id = c.org_id AND m.created_at > a.created_at AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(m.roles) r WHERE r.value IN ('org_admin', 'template_reviewer'))))
      AND (a.kind != 'peer' OR (a.reviewer_id != c.author_id
        AND (c.version_author_id IS NULL OR a.reviewer_id != c.version_author_id)))
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid template release approval') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.action = 'release' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM template_releases r WHERE r.candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id AND r.source = 'approved'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'template candidate already released') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.action = 'rollback' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM template_releases r WHERE r.id = NEW.rollback_of_release_id AND r.source = 'approved'
      AND r.template_id = NEW.template_id AND r.org_id IS NEW.org_id AND r.mode = NEW.mode
      AND r.provider = NEW.provider AND (r.generation < NEW.generation - 1 OR (
        r.generation = NEW.generation - 1 AND NEW.mode = 'live'
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM templates restore_template WHERE restore_template.id = NEW.template_id
          AND restore_template.status = 'archived' AND restore_template.org_id = NEW.org_id)))
      AND r.candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id AND r.approval_id = NEW.approval_id
      AND r.candidate_hash = NEW.candidate_hash AND r.version = NEW.version
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid template rollback') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.adapter_revision < COALESCE((
    SELECT r.adapter_revision FROM template_releases r WHERE r.template_id = NEW.template_id
      AND r.org_id IS NEW.org_id AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider
    ORDER BY r.generation DESC LIMIT 1), 0) OR NEW.audience_policy_revision < COALESCE((
    SELECT r.audience_policy_revision FROM template_releases r WHERE r.template_id = NEW.template_id
      AND r.org_id IS NEW.org_id AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider
    ORDER BY r.generation DESC LIMIT 1), 0) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'stale template policy') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_credential_transfer_required
BEFORE UPDATE OF holder_email, owner_user_id, serial, auth_token, scan_code, identity_id, org_id, mode ON passes
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t WHERE t.pass_id = OLD.id AND t.state = 'pending')
  AND (NEW.holder_email IS NOT OLD.holder_email
    OR (NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT OLD.owner_user_id
      AND NOT (OLD.owner_user_id IS NULL AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
        AND NEW.deleted_at IS NULL AND NEW.test_data_quarantined = 0
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u JOIN user_emails e ON e.user_id = u.id
          WHERE u.id = NEW.owner_user_id AND u.status = 'active' AND e.email = NEW.holder_email)
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_attach_blocks b WHERE b.pass_id = OLD.id AND b.user_id = NEW.owner_user_id))
      AND NOT (OLD.owner_user_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.owner_user_id IS NULL
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_attach_blocks b WHERE b.pass_id = OLD.id AND b.user_id = OLD.owner_user_id)))
    OR NEW.serial IS NOT OLD.serial
    OR (NEW.auth_token IS NOT OLD.auth_token
      AND NOT ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM token_remac_marks m WHERE m.pass_id = OLD.id AND m.kind = 'auth' AND m.mac = NEW.auth_token))
        AND NEW.credential_generation IS OLD.credential_generation))
    OR NEW.identity_id IS NOT OLD.identity_id OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
    OR (OLD.scan_code IS NOT NULL AND NEW.scan_code IS NOT OLD.scan_code AND (NEW.scan_code IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_code_rotations r WHERE r.pass_id = OLD.id
      AND r.new_version = NEW.version AND NEW.version = OLD.version + 1))))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'credential transfer required'); END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_events_feed AFTER INSERT ON pass_events
WHEN NEW.kind IN ('pass.issued', 'pass.updated', 'pass.voided', 'pass.unvoided', 'pass.removed',
    'pass.restored', 'device.registered', 'device.unregistered', 'scan.checked_in', 'scan.redeemed',
    'scan.adjusted', 'scan.checked_out', 'scan.heads_up', 'scan.rejected', 'scan.undone',
    'push.failed', 'email.failed', 'pass.channels_changed', 'pass.printed', 'pass.print_voided')
  AND NOT (NEW.kind = 'pass.updated' AND json_extract(NEW.data, '$.cause') IS 'resign')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM settings WHERE scope = 'platform' AND key = 'events.feed' AND value = '"off"')
BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO event_feed (event_id, org_id, mode, pass_id, template_id, external_id, type,
    kind, device, device_count, actor_type, data, at)
  SELECT NEW.id, p.org_id, p.mode, p.id, p.template_id, p.external_id,
    CASE NEW.kind
      WHEN 'device.registered' THEN 'pass.installed'
      WHEN 'device.unregistered' THEN 'pass.uninstalled'
      WHEN 'scan.rejected' THEN 'pass.scan_refused'
      WHEN 'scan.undone' THEN 'pass.scan_undone'
      WHEN 'scan.checked_in' THEN 'pass.scanned' WHEN 'scan.redeemed' THEN 'pass.scanned'
      WHEN 'scan.adjusted' THEN 'pass.scanned' WHEN 'scan.checked_out' THEN 'pass.scanned'
      WHEN 'scan.heads_up' THEN 'pass.scanned'
      ELSE NEW.kind END,
    NEW.kind, NEW.device,
    CASE WHEN NEW.kind IN ('device.registered', 'device.unregistered')
      THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM registrations r WHERE r.pass_id = p.id
        AND r.credential_generation = p.credential_generation) END,
    NEW.actor_type, NEW.data, NEW.at
  FROM passes p JOIN orgs o ON o.id = p.org_id AND o.status = 'active'
  WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id AND p.org_id = NEW.org_id AND p.mode = NEW.mode
    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.test_data_quarantined = 0;

  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO webhook_deliveries (endpoint_id, event_seq, org_id, mode)
  SELECT e.id, f.seq, f.org_id, f.mode
  FROM event_feed f
  JOIN webhook_endpoints e ON e.org_id = f.org_id AND e.mode = f.mode
  WHERE f.event_id = NEW.id
    AND e.status IN ('active', 'paused')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(e.event_types) t WHERE t.value = f.type)
    AND (e.template_ids IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(e.template_ids) t WHERE t.value = f.template_id));
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_credentials_step
BEFORE UPDATE OF revision, current_version_id, verified_at, revoked_at ON wallet_credentials
WHEN (NEW.revision IS NOT OLD.revision OR NEW.current_version_id IS NOT OLD.current_version_id
    OR NEW.verified_at IS NOT OLD.verified_at OR NEW.revoked_at IS NOT OLD.revoked_at)
  AND NOT (NEW.revision = OLD.revision + 1 AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_credential_events e WHERE e.credential_id = NEW.id AND e.revision = NEW.revision
      AND ((e.kind = 'create' AND OLD.current_version_id IS NULL AND NEW.current_version_id = e.version_id
          AND NEW.verified_at IS OLD.verified_at AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NULL)
        OR (e.kind = 'rotate' AND OLD.current_version_id IS NOT NULL
          AND NEW.current_version_id = e.version_id AND NEW.current_version_id IS NOT OLD.current_version_id
          AND NEW.verified_at IS OLD.verified_at AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NULL)
        OR (e.kind = 'revoke' AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
          AND NEW.current_version_id IS OLD.current_version_id AND NEW.verified_at IS OLD.verified_at)
        OR (e.kind = 'verify' AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NULL
          AND NEW.current_version_id IS OLD.current_version_id AND NEW.verified_at = e.created_at
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_credential_checks k WHERE k.credential_id = NEW.id
            AND k.version_id = NEW.current_version_id AND k.ok = 1)))))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid wallet credential transition'); END

  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_credential_versions o, json_each(o.card_map) k
    WHERE o.id = OLD.current_version_id AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM wallet_credential_versions n, json_each(n.card_map) m
      WHERE n.id = NEW.current_version_id AND m.key = k.key AND m.value IS k.value))

  SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_accounts a JOIN wallet_provider_instances i ON i.account_id = a.id

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_credentials_revoke_off AFTER UPDATE OF revoked_at ON wallet_credentials
WHEN OLD.revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO wallet_enrolment_events (id, account_id, org_id, mode, provider, enrolment_revision, kind,
    credential_id, reason, actor_type, actor_id, request_id, created_at)
  SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), a.id, a.org_id, a.mode, a.provider,
    MAX(a.enrolment_revision, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(x.enrolment_revision) FROM wallet_enrolment_events x
      WHERE x.account_id = a.id), 0)) + 1,
    'disable', NEW.id, 'source_revoked', r.actor_type, r.actor_id, r.request_id,
    CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)
  FROM wallet_provider_accounts a
  JOIN wallet_credential_events r ON r.credential_id = NEW.id AND r.revision = NEW.revision
  WHERE a.credential_source_id = NEW.id AND a.enabled_at IS NOT NULL;
  UPDATE wallet_provider_accounts SET enabled_at = NULL, enrolment_revision = (
    SELECT MAX(e.enrolment_revision) FROM wallet_enrolment_events e
    WHERE e.account_id = wallet_provider_accounts.id AND e.kind = 'disable' AND e.reason = 'source_revoked'
      AND e.credential_id = NEW.id)
  WHERE credential_source_id = NEW.id AND enabled_at IS NOT NULL;
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_credentials_audit AFTER UPDATE OF revision ON wallet_credentials
WHEN NEW.revision IS NOT OLD.revision
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO audit_log (at, org_id, actor_type, actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, request_id, ip_prefix, detail)
  SELECT e.created_at, NEW.org_id, CASE e.actor_type WHEN 'system' THEN 'system' ELSE 'user' END, e.actor_id,
    'wallet_provider.credential_' || e.kind, 'wallet_credential', NEW.id, e.request_id, NULL,
    json_object('mode', NEW.mode, 'provider', NEW.provider, 'scope', NEW.scope, 'revision', e.revision,
      'actor', e.actor_type)
  FROM wallet_credential_events e WHERE e.credential_id = NEW.id AND e.revision = NEW.revision;
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_accounts_transition
BEFORE UPDATE OF id, org_id, mode, provider, created_at, revision, credential_id, revoked_at ON wallet_provider_accounts
WHEN NOT (OLD.credential_id IS NULL AND NEW.credential_id IS NULL AND NEW.revision = OLD.revision
    AND NEW.id IS OLD.id AND NEW.org_id IS OLD.org_id AND NEW.mode IS OLD.mode
    AND NEW.provider IS OLD.provider AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at
    AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL)
  AND (NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
  OR NEW.provider IS NOT OLD.provider OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
  OR NEW.revision != OLD.revision + 1
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_account_events e
    JOIN wallet_provider_credentials c ON c.id = e.credential_id
      AND c.account_id = NEW.id AND c.org_id = NEW.org_id
      AND c.mode = NEW.mode AND c.provider = NEW.provider
    WHERE e.account_id = NEW.id AND e.org_id = NEW.org_id AND e.mode = NEW.mode
      AND e.provider = NEW.provider AND e.revision = NEW.revision
      AND e.credential_id = NEW.credential_id AND e.created_at = NEW.updated_at
      AND ((e.kind = 'configure' AND NEW.credential_id IS NOT OLD.credential_id AND NEW.revoked_at IS NULL)
        OR (e.kind = 'revoke' AND OLD.credential_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL
            AND NEW.credential_id = OLD.credential_id
            AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND OLD.enabled_at IS NULL AND NEW.enabled_at IS NULL
            AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances i WHERE i.account_id = OLD.id AND i.lifecycle != 'retired')))
  ))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid wallet provider account transition'); END

  SELECT e.created_at, e.org_id, 'user', e.actor_id, 'wallet_provider.account_' || e.kind,
    'wallet_provider_account', e.account_id, e.request_id, NULL,
    json_object('mode', e.mode, 'provider', e.provider, 'revision', e.revision)
  FROM wallet_provider_account_events e WHERE e.account_id = NEW.id AND e.revision = NEW.revision;
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_enrolments_insert BEFORE INSERT ON wallet_provider_accounts
WHEN NEW.credential_source_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.identity_hash IS NOT NULL OR NEW.enabled_at IS NOT NULL
  OR NEW.enrolment_revision != 0 OR NEW.platform_hold_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.platform_hold_reason IS NOT NULL
  OR NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'wallet enrolment starts without a source'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_enrolments_step
BEFORE UPDATE OF credential_source_id, identity_hash, enabled_at, enrolment_revision, platform_hold_at,
  platform_hold_reason ON wallet_provider_accounts
WHEN (NEW.credential_source_id IS NOT OLD.credential_source_id OR NEW.identity_hash IS NOT OLD.identity_hash
    OR NEW.enabled_at IS NOT OLD.enabled_at OR NEW.enrolment_revision IS NOT OLD.enrolment_revision
    OR NEW.platform_hold_at IS NOT OLD.platform_hold_at
    OR NEW.platform_hold_reason IS NOT OLD.platform_hold_reason)
  AND NOT (NEW.enrolment_revision > OLD.enrolment_revision AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_enrolment_events e
    WHERE e.account_id = NEW.id AND e.enrolment_revision = NEW.enrolment_revision
      AND (NEW.enrolment_revision = OLD.enrolment_revision + 1
        OR e.kind IN ('hold', 'release') OR (e.kind = 'disable' AND e.reason = 'source_revoked'))
      AND (NEW.revoked_at IS OLD.revoked_at OR e.kind = 'revoke')
      AND ((e.kind = 'source' AND e.credential_id = NEW.credential_source_id
          AND NEW.credential_source_id IS NOT OLD.credential_source_id AND NEW.enabled_at IS NULL AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL
          AND NEW.platform_hold_at IS OLD.platform_hold_at
          AND NEW.platform_hold_reason IS OLD.platform_hold_reason)
        OR (e.kind = 'enable' AND OLD.enabled_at IS NULL AND NEW.enabled_at = e.created_at
          AND NEW.credential_source_id IS OLD.credential_source_id AND NEW.identity_hash IS OLD.identity_hash
          AND NEW.platform_hold_at IS OLD.platform_hold_at
          AND NEW.platform_hold_reason IS OLD.platform_hold_reason)
        OR (e.kind = 'disable' AND OLD.enabled_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.enabled_at IS NULL
          AND NEW.credential_source_id IS OLD.credential_source_id AND NEW.identity_hash IS OLD.identity_hash
          AND NEW.platform_hold_at IS OLD.platform_hold_at
          AND NEW.platform_hold_reason IS OLD.platform_hold_reason)
        OR (e.kind = 'hold' AND OLD.platform_hold_at IS NULL AND NEW.platform_hold_at = e.created_at
          AND NEW.platform_hold_reason IS e.reason AND NEW.enabled_at IS NULL
          AND NEW.credential_source_id IS OLD.credential_source_id AND NEW.identity_hash IS OLD.identity_hash)
        OR (e.kind = 'release' AND OLD.platform_hold_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.platform_hold_at IS NULL
          AND NEW.platform_hold_reason IS NULL AND NEW.enabled_at IS OLD.enabled_at
          AND NEW.credential_source_id IS OLD.credential_source_id AND NEW.identity_hash IS OLD.identity_hash)
        OR (e.kind = 'revoke' AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at = e.created_at
          AND OLD.enabled_at IS NULL AND NEW.enabled_at IS NULL
          AND NEW.credential_source_id IS OLD.credential_source_id AND NEW.identity_hash IS OLD.identity_hash
          AND NEW.platform_hold_at IS OLD.platform_hold_at
          AND NEW.platform_hold_reason IS OLD.platform_hold_reason))))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'wallet enrolment change needs its event'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_enrolments_enable_check BEFORE UPDATE OF enabled_at ON wallet_provider_accounts

  SELECT 1 FROM wallet_enrolment_events e
  JOIN wallet_credentials c ON c.id = e.credential_id
  JOIN wallet_credential_checks k ON k.id = e.check_id AND k.credential_id = c.id
    AND k.version_id = c.current_version_id
  WHERE e.account_id = NEW.id AND e.enrolment_revision = NEW.enrolment_revision AND e.kind = 'enable'
    AND e.credential_id = NEW.credential_source_id AND k.ok = 1
    AND k.checked_at >= CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER) - 86400000)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'wallet enrolment enable needs a fresh credential check'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_enrolments_enable_round_trip BEFORE UPDATE OF enabled_at ON wallet_provider_accounts
WHEN OLD.enabled_at IS NULL AND NEW.enabled_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.mode = 'live' AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM wallet_enrolment_events e
  JOIN wallet_provider_accounts t ON t.org_id = NEW.org_id AND t.mode = 'test' AND t.provider = NEW.provider
    AND t.credential_source_id IS NOT NULL
  WHERE e.account_id = NEW.id AND e.enrolment_revision = NEW.enrolment_revision AND e.kind = 'enable'
    AND ((NEW.provider = 'google' AND e.round_trip_kind = 'google_save' AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_callback_receipts r WHERE r.id = e.round_trip_id
          AND r.account_id = t.id AND r.org_id = t.org_id AND r.mode = 'test' AND r.event_type = 'save'
          AND r.received_at > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.created_at) FROM wallet_enrolment_events s
            WHERE s.account_id = t.id AND s.kind = 'source'), 0)))
      OR (NEW.provider = 'samsung' AND e.round_trip_kind = 'samsung_added' AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_callback_receipts r WHERE r.id = e.round_trip_id
          AND r.account_id = t.id AND r.org_id = t.org_id AND r.mode = 'test' AND r.event = 'ADDED'
          AND r.received_at > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.created_at) FROM wallet_enrolment_events s
            WHERE s.account_id = t.id AND s.kind = 'source'), 0)))))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'wallet enrolment enable needs a Test round trip'); END

    AND keyset.commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment)
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM passes p WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id AND p.org_id = NEW.org_id AND p.mode = NEW.mode
      AND NEW.credential_generation > 1
      AND p.credential_generation = NEW.credential_generation
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers pending WHERE pending.pass_id = p.id
        AND pending.org_id = p.org_id AND pending.mode = p.mode AND pending.state = 'pending'
        AND pending.target_generation = NEW.credential_generation)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t
        WHERE t.pass_id = p.id AND t.target_generation = NEW.credential_generation AND t.state = 'completed')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances current
        WHERE current.pass_id = p.id AND current.provider = NEW.provider
          AND current.credential_generation = NEW.credential_generation)
  )
)

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_instances_channel_off BEFORE UPDATE OF retirement_cause ON wallet_provider_instances
WHEN NEW.retirement_cause IS NOT OLD.retirement_cause AND NOT (
  OLD.retirement_cause IS NULL AND NEW.retirement_cause = 'channel_off'
  AND OLD.retirement_requested_at IS NULL AND NEW.retirement_requested_at IS NOT NULL
  AND NEW.lifecycle IN ('active', 'revoking', 'revoked')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM passes p WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id AND p.org_id = NEW.org_id AND p.mode = NEW.mode
    AND p.credential_generation = NEW.credential_generation)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_channels c WHERE c.pass_id = NEW.pass_id AND c.org_id = NEW.org_id
    AND c.mode = NEW.mode AND c.channel = NEW.provider AND c.retired_at IS NOT NULL)
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provider channel retirement is not allowed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_channels_provider_dirty_insert AFTER INSERT ON pass_channels
WHEN NEW.channel IN ('google', 'samsung') AND NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO wallet_provider_instance_dirty(instance_id, generation)
  SELECT i.id, 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances i
  WHERE i.pass_id = NEW.pass_id AND i.org_id = NEW.org_id AND i.mode = NEW.mode AND i.provider = NEW.channel
    AND i.lifecycle IN ('active', 'revoking', 'revoked') AND i.retirement_requested_at IS NULL
  ON CONFLICT(instance_id) DO UPDATE SET generation = generation + 1, next_attempt_at = 0;
END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_channels_provider_dirty_update AFTER UPDATE OF retired_at ON pass_channels
WHEN NEW.channel IN ('google', 'samsung') AND NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO wallet_provider_instance_dirty(instance_id, generation)
  SELECT i.id, 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances i
  WHERE i.pass_id = NEW.pass_id AND i.org_id = NEW.org_id AND i.mode = NEW.mode AND i.provider = NEW.channel

CREATE TRIGGER channel_apply_runs_tenant BEFORE INSERT ON channel_apply_runs
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM templates t WHERE t.id = NEW.template_id AND (t.org_id = NEW.org_id OR t.org_id IS NULL))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'channel apply run tenant mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER channel_apply_runs_insert BEFORE INSERT ON channel_apply_runs
WHEN NEW.state != 'pending'
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'channel apply run must start pending'); END

CREATE TRIGGER channel_apply_runs_key BEFORE UPDATE ON channel_apply_runs
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
  OR NEW.template_id IS NOT OLD.template_id OR NEW.from_channels IS NOT OLD.from_channels
  OR NEW.from_revision IS NOT OLD.from_revision OR NEW.requested_by IS NOT OLD.requested_by
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'channel apply run key is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER channel_apply_runs_state BEFORE UPDATE ON channel_apply_runs
WHEN OLD.state IN ('done', 'dropped', 'failed')
  OR (NEW.replace_channels IS NOT OLD.replace_channels AND OLD.state != 'pending')
  OR (NEW.state IS NOT OLD.state AND NOT (
    (OLD.state = 'pending' AND NEW.state IN ('running', 'dropped', 'failed'))
    OR (OLD.state = 'running' AND NEW.state IN ('done', 'failed'))))
  OR ((NEW.to_channels IS NOT OLD.to_channels OR NEW.to_revision IS NOT OLD.to_revision)
    AND NOT (OLD.state = 'pending' AND NEW.state = 'running'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid channel apply run transition'); END

WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_apply_runs r JOIN passes p ON p.id = NEW.pass_id

BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'channel apply mark tenant mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER channel_apply_marks_once BEFORE UPDATE ON channel_apply_marks
WHEN NEW.run_id IS NOT OLD.run_id OR NEW.pass_id IS NOT OLD.pass_id OR NEW.events IS NOT OLD.events
  OR (NEW.journaled_at IS NOT OLD.journaled_at AND OLD.journaled_at IS NOT NULL)
  OR (NEW.notice_at IS NOT OLD.notice_at AND OLD.notice_at IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'channel apply mark is write-once'); END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_prints_new_code AFTER INSERT ON scan_code_rotations
WHEN NEW.actor_id IS NULL OR NOT (NEW.actor_id LIKE 'channel_apply:%'
  OR NEW.actor_id LIKE 'channel_bulk:%' OR NEW.actor_id LIKE 'channel_replace:%')
BEGIN
  UPDATE pass_prints SET status = 'voided', voided_at = NEW.rotated_at, void_cause = 'new_code'

END

CREATE TRIGGER scan_retained_gates_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON scan_retained_gates
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_retained_gates WHERE scan_id=NEW.scan_id)
  OR (NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM scans s
    JOIN passes p ON p.id=s.pass_id AND p.org_id=s.org_id AND p.mode=s.mode AND p.test_data_quarantined=0
    JOIN scan_retention_proofs proof ON proof.scan_id=s.id AND proof.org_id=s.org_id AND proof.mode=s.mode
      AND proof.pass_ref=NEW.pass_ref AND proof.excluded=0 AND proof.invalidated=0 AND proof.occupancy_invalidated=0
    JOIN scan_retention_delete_intents intent ON intent.org_id=s.org_id AND intent.mode=s.mode
      AND intent.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref
    JOIN scans anchor ON anchor.id=intent.scan_id AND anchor.pass_id=p.id
    JOIN scan_retention_event_transitions committed ON committed.scan_id=s.id AND committed.org_id=s.org_id
      AND committed.mode=s.mode AND committed.event_id=s.event_id AND committed.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref
    WHERE s.id=NEW.scan_id AND s.org_id=NEW.org_id AND s.mode=NEW.mode AND s.event_id=NEW.event_id
      AND s.state='done' AND s.outcome='ok' AND s.action_kind IN ('check_in','undo')
      AND NEW.state=NEW.presence_state AND proof.gate_snapshot IS NOT NULL
      AND json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.kind')='check_in'
      AND json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.lastScanId')=s.id
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_retention_event_transitions later
        LEFT JOIN scans later_scan ON later_scan.id=later.scan_id
        WHERE later.org_id=committed.org_id AND later.mode=committed.mode
          AND later.event_id=committed.event_id AND later.sequence>committed.sequence
          AND (later.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref OR (later.pass_ref IS NULL AND later_scan.pass_id=p.id))
          AND later_scan.action_kind IS NOT 'undo' AND later_scan.undone_by IS NULL)
      AND (
        (proof.presence_snapshot IS NOT NULL
          AND NEW.state=json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.state')
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_presence presence
            WHERE presence.pass_id=p.id AND presence.org_id=s.org_id AND presence.scope='event:' || s.event_id
              AND (presence.scope IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.scope')
              AND presence.state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.state')
              AND presence.tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.tracking')
              AND presence.entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.enteredAt')
              AND presence.first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.firstAt')
              AND presence.last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.lastEntryAt')
              AND presence.last_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.lastScanId')
              AND presence.prev_state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevState')
              AND presence.prev_tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevTracking')
              AND presence.prev_entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevEnteredAt')
              AND presence.prev_first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevFirstAt')
              AND presence.prev_last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevLastEntryAt')
              AND presence.prev_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevScanId'))))
        OR (proof.presence_snapshot IS NULL
          AND NEW.state=json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.state')
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_presence presence WHERE presence.pass_id=p.id
            AND presence.scope='event:' || s.event_id)
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_gates g
            WHERE g.pass_id=p.id AND g.org_id=s.org_id AND g.mode=s.mode AND g.template_id=s.template_id
              AND g.action_id IS s.action_id AND g.scope='event:' || s.event_id
              AND (g.scope IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.scope')
              AND g.kind IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.kind')
              AND g.state IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.state')
              AND g.count IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.count')
              AND g.first_at IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.firstAt')
              AND g.last_at IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.lastAt')
              AND g.last_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.lastScanId')
              AND g.prev_state IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.prevState')
              AND g.prev_last_at IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.prevLastAt')
              AND g.prev_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.gate_snapshot,'$.prevScanId'))))
      )
  ) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM scans s
    JOIN passes p ON p.id=s.pass_id AND p.org_id=s.org_id AND p.mode=s.mode AND p.test_data_quarantined=0
    JOIN scan_retention_proofs proof ON proof.scan_id=s.id AND proof.org_id=s.org_id AND proof.mode=s.mode
      AND proof.excluded=0 AND proof.invalidated=0 AND proof.occupancy_invalidated=0
    JOIN scan_presence presence ON presence.pass_id=p.id AND presence.org_id=s.org_id
      AND presence.scope='event:' || s.event_id AND presence.last_scan_id=s.id
    JOIN scans c ON c.id=json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevScanId') AND c.pass_id=p.id
      AND c.org_id=s.org_id AND c.mode=s.mode AND c.event_id=s.event_id AND c.state='done' AND c.outcome='ok'
      AND c.action_kind IN ('check_in','undo')
    JOIN scan_retention_proofs cp ON cp.scan_id=c.id AND cp.org_id=c.org_id AND cp.mode=c.mode
      AND cp.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref AND cp.excluded=0 AND cp.invalidated=0 AND cp.occupancy_invalidated=0
      AND (c.action_kind='check_in' OR cp.gate_snapshot IS NOT NULL)
    JOIN scan_retention_delete_intents intent ON intent.org_id=s.org_id AND intent.mode=s.mode
      AND intent.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref
    JOIN scans anchor ON anchor.id=intent.scan_id AND anchor.pass_id=p.id
    WHERE s.id=NEW.scan_id AND s.org_id=NEW.org_id AND s.mode=NEW.mode AND s.event_id=NEW.event_id
      AND proof.pass_ref=NEW.pass_ref AND NEW.state='out' AND NEW.presence_state='out'
      AND s.state='done' AND s.outcome='ok' AND s.out_cause IN ('desk','stay','clear','zone') AND s.direction='out'
      AND s.action_kind IS NOT 'undo' AND s.undoes IS NULL AND s.event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND proof.gate_snapshot IS NULL AND proof.presence_snapshot IS NOT NULL
      AND json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.state')='out'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_quarantine_exclusions q WHERE q.scan_id IN (s.id,c.id))
      AND (presence.scope IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.scope')
      AND presence.state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.state')
      AND presence.tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.tracking')
      AND presence.entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.enteredAt')
      AND presence.first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.firstAt')
      AND presence.last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.lastEntryAt')
      AND presence.last_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.lastScanId')
      AND presence.prev_state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevState')
      AND presence.prev_tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevTracking')
      AND presence.prev_entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevEnteredAt')
      AND presence.prev_first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevFirstAt')
      AND presence.prev_last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevLastEntryAt')
      AND presence.prev_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevScanId'))
  ))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid retained gate source');
END

CREATE TRIGGER scan_retention_capture_exit_gates BEFORE DELETE ON passes
WHEN OLD.test_data_quarantined = 0
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO scan_retained_gates (scan_id, org_id, mode, event_id, pass_ref, state, presence_state)
  SELECT s.id, s.org_id, s.mode, s.event_id, intent.pass_ref, 'out', 'out'
  FROM scans s
  JOIN passes p ON p.id=s.pass_id AND p.org_id=s.org_id AND p.mode=s.mode AND p.test_data_quarantined=0
  JOIN scan_retention_proofs proof ON proof.scan_id=s.id AND proof.org_id=s.org_id AND proof.mode=s.mode
    AND proof.excluded=0 AND proof.invalidated=0 AND proof.occupancy_invalidated=0
  JOIN scan_presence presence ON presence.pass_id=p.id AND presence.org_id=s.org_id
    AND presence.scope='event:' || s.event_id AND presence.last_scan_id=s.id
  JOIN scans c ON c.id=json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevScanId') AND c.pass_id=p.id
    AND c.org_id=s.org_id AND c.mode=s.mode AND c.event_id=s.event_id AND c.state='done' AND c.outcome='ok'
    AND c.action_kind IN ('check_in','undo')
  JOIN scan_retention_proofs cp ON cp.scan_id=c.id AND cp.org_id=c.org_id AND cp.mode=c.mode
    AND cp.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref AND cp.excluded=0 AND cp.invalidated=0 AND cp.occupancy_invalidated=0
    AND (c.action_kind='check_in' OR cp.gate_snapshot IS NOT NULL)
  JOIN scan_retention_delete_intents intent ON intent.org_id=s.org_id AND intent.mode=s.mode
    AND intent.pass_ref=proof.pass_ref
  JOIN scans anchor ON anchor.id=intent.scan_id AND anchor.pass_id=p.id
  WHERE p.id=OLD.id AND s.pass_id=OLD.id AND s.state='done' AND s.outcome='ok' AND s.out_cause IN ('desk','stay','clear','zone') AND s.direction='out'
  AND s.action_kind IS NOT 'undo' AND s.undoes IS NULL AND s.event_id IS NOT NULL
  AND proof.gate_snapshot IS NULL AND proof.presence_snapshot IS NOT NULL
  AND json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.state')='out'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_quarantine_exclusions q WHERE q.scan_id IN (s.id,c.id))
  AND (presence.scope IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.scope')
  AND presence.state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.state')
  AND presence.tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.tracking')
  AND presence.entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.enteredAt')
  AND presence.first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.firstAt')
  AND presence.last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.lastEntryAt')
  AND presence.last_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.lastScanId')
  AND presence.prev_state IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevState')
  AND presence.prev_tracking IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevTracking')
  AND presence.prev_entered_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevEnteredAt')
  AND presence.prev_first_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevFirstAt')
  AND presence.prev_last_entry_at IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevLastEntryAt')
  AND presence.prev_scan_id IS json_extract(proof.presence_snapshot,'$.prevScanId'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scan_retained_gates retained WHERE retained.scan_id=s.id);
END

CREATE TRIGGER nfc_tag_systems_no_insert BEFORE INSERT ON nfc_tag_systems

BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_system_fixed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER tag_bindings_update_check BEFORE UPDATE ON tag_bindings
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_binding_immutable') WHERE OLD.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.tag_id IS NOT OLD.tag_id OR NEW.scope IS NOT OLD.scope
    OR NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id OR NEW.source IS NOT OLD.source OR NEW.bound_at IS NOT OLD.bound_at
    OR NEW.bound_by_type IS NOT OLD.bound_by_type OR NEW.bound_by IS NOT OLD.bound_by
    OR NEW.scanner_id IS NOT OLD.scanner_id
    OR NEW.holder_generation IS NOT OLD.holder_generation OR NEW.holder_owner IS NOT OLD.holder_owner
    OR (NEW.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.pass_id IS NOT OLD.pass_id);
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_binding_reanchor') WHERE NEW.pass_id IS NOT OLD.pass_id AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM passes p JOIN nfc_tags t ON t.id = NEW.tag_id
    WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id AND NEW.scope = 'user' AND p.owner_user_id = NEW.user_id
      AND p.org_id = t.org_id AND p.mode = t.mode AND p.deleted_at IS NULL);
END

CREATE TRIGGER nfc_tags_retire_ends AFTER UPDATE OF status ON nfc_tags WHEN NEW.status = 'retired'
BEGIN
  UPDATE tag_bindings SET ended_at = CAST(unixepoch('now', 'subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER), ended_by_type = 'system',
    ended_by = 'tags', end_cause = 'tag_retired'
  WHERE tag_id = NEW.id AND ended_at IS NULL;
END

CREATE TRIGGER tag_enrollments_update_check BEFORE UPDATE ON tag_enrollments
BEGIN
  -- A finished request keeps its row; only the binding it made may go (the foreign key sets it NULL).
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'enrollment_immutable') WHERE (OLD.state <> 'pending'
      AND NOT (NEW.binding_id IS NULL AND OLD.binding_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.state IS OLD.state
        AND NEW.ended_at IS OLD.ended_at AND NEW.error_code IS OLD.error_code AND NEW.shown_at IS OLD.shown_at))
    OR NEW.holder_generation IS NOT OLD.holder_generation OR NEW.holder_owner IS NOT OLD.holder_owner
    OR NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
    OR NEW.pass_id IS NOT OLD.pass_id OR NEW.scanner_id IS NOT OLD.scanner_id
    OR NEW.requested_by IS NOT OLD.requested_by OR NEW.scope IS NOT OLD.scope
    OR NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
    OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at
    OR (OLD.shown_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.shown_at IS NOT OLD.shown_at);
END

CREATE TRIGGER nfc_tags_system_insert BEFORE INSERT ON nfc_tags
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_system_disabled') WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tag_systems s WHERE s.id = NEW.system AND s.enabled = 1);
END

CREATE TRIGGER tag_bindings_type_check BEFORE INSERT ON tag_bindings
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tags t WHERE t.id = NEW.tag_id AND t.type_id IS NOT NULL)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_type_scope') WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tags t JOIN nfc_tag_types y ON y.id = t.type_id
    WHERE t.id = NEW.tag_id AND y.scopes <> 'both' AND y.scopes <> NEW.scope);
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_type_limit') WHERE NEW.scope = 'pass'
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM tag_bindings b JOIN nfc_tags bt ON bt.id = b.tag_id
      WHERE b.pass_id = NEW.pass_id AND b.scope = 'pass' AND b.ended_at IS NULL
        AND bt.type_id = (SELECT t.type_id FROM nfc_tags t WHERE t.id = NEW.tag_id))
    >= (SELECT y.per_pass FROM nfc_tags t JOIN nfc_tag_types y ON y.id = t.type_id WHERE t.id = NEW.tag_id);
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_type_template') WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tags t JOIN nfc_tag_type_templates tt ON tt.type_id = t.type_id WHERE t.id = NEW.tag_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tags t JOIN nfc_tag_type_templates tt ON tt.type_id = t.type_id
      JOIN passes p ON p.template_id = tt.template_id
      WHERE t.id = NEW.tag_id AND p.id = NEW.pass_id);
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_credentials_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON wallet_provider_credentials
WHEN NOT (NEW.kek_version > OLD.kek_version AND NEW.wrapped_dek IS NOT OLD.wrapped_dek
  AND NEW.iv IS OLD.iv AND NEW.ciphertext IS OLD.ciphertext AND NEW.id IS OLD.id
  AND NEW.account_id IS OLD.account_id AND NEW.org_id IS OLD.org_id AND NEW.mode IS OLD.mode
  AND NEW.provider IS OLD.provider AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at
  AND NEW.identity_hash IS OLD.identity_hash)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable wallet provider credential'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_accounts_authority_epoch
AFTER UPDATE OF revoked_at, identity_hash, credential_id ON wallet_provider_accounts
WHEN NEW.authority_epoch = OLD.authority_epoch AND (
  NEW.revoked_at IS NOT OLD.revoked_at
  OR NEW.identity_hash IS NOT OLD.identity_hash
  OR (NEW.credential_id IS NOT OLD.credential_id AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_credentials n JOIN wallet_provider_credentials o ON o.identity_hash = n.identity_hash
    WHERE n.id = NEW.credential_id AND o.id = OLD.credential_id)))
BEGIN
  UPDATE wallet_provider_accounts SET authority_epoch = authority_epoch + 1 WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid;
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_accounts_authority_epoch_monotonic
BEFORE UPDATE OF authority_epoch ON wallet_provider_accounts

CREATE TRIGGER api_keys_v2_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON api_keys
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.kind IS NOT OLD.kind
    OR NEW.roles IS NOT OLD.roles
    OR NEW.membership_id IS NOT OLD.membership_id
    OR NEW.restricted IS NOT OLD.restricted
    OR NEW.ip_allow IS NOT OLD.ip_allow
    OR NEW.secret_label IS NOT OLD.secret_label
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'api key identity is immutable') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.retire_at IS NOT OLD.retire_at AND (
    OLD.retire_at IS NOT NULL OR typeof(NEW.retire_at) != 'integer'
    OR (NEW.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.retire_at > NEW.expires_at)
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'api key retirement is set once, before expiry') END;
END

      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM org_memberships m
        WHERE m.id = NEW.membership_id AND m.org_id = NEW.org_id AND m.revoked_at IS NULL)))
  OR (NEW.kind <> 'personal' AND NEW.membership_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (NEW.kind = 'platform' AND NEW.roles <> '[]')
  OR (NEW.kind <> 'platform' AND NEW.org_id IS NULL)
  OR (NEW.kind = 'platform' AND (NEW.org_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.expires_at IS NULL
      OR NEW.expires_at > NEW.created_at + 7862400000
      OR NEW.ip_allow IS NULL OR json_array_length(NEW.ip_allow) = 0))

CREATE TRIGGER scanning_sessions_change_log
AFTER UPDATE OF status, settings, hours, hold, time_zone ON scanning_sessions
WHEN OLD.status IS NOT NEW.status OR OLD.hours IS NOT NEW.hours OR OLD.hold IS NOT NEW.hold
  OR OLD.time_zone IS NOT NEW.time_zone
  OR COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(OLD.settings) THEN COALESCE(json_extract(OLD.settings, '$.whenOffline'),
       CASE WHEN json_extract(OLD.settings, '$.offline') THEN 'list' ELSE 'stop' END) END, 'stop')
     IS NOT COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.settings) THEN COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.settings, '$.whenOffline'),
       CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.settings, '$.offline') THEN 'list' ELSE 'stop' END) END, 'stop')
BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO scan_session_changes
    (session_id, org_id, at, status, mode, prev_status, prev_mode, timing, prev_timing)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id, NEW.org_id, NEW.updated_at, NEW.status,
    COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.settings) THEN COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.settings, '$.whenOffline'),
      CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.settings, '$.offline') THEN 'list' ELSE 'stop' END) END, 'stop'),
    OLD.status,
    COALESCE(CASE WHEN json_valid(OLD.settings) THEN COALESCE(json_extract(OLD.settings, '$.whenOffline'),
      CASE WHEN json_extract(OLD.settings, '$.offline') THEN 'list' ELSE 'stop' END) END, 'stop'),
    json_object('hours', NEW.hours, 'hold', NEW.hold, 'timeZone', NEW.time_zone),
    json_object('hours', OLD.hours, 'hold', OLD.hold, 'timeZone', OLD.time_zone)
  );
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_transfer_complete_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON pass_credential_transfers
WHEN OLD.state = 'pending' AND NEW.state = 'completed' AND (
  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM passes p WHERE p.id = OLD.pass_id AND p.org_id = OLD.org_id AND p.mode = OLD.mode
    AND p.credential_generation = OLD.target_generation)
  OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallet_provider_instances i
    JOIN wallet_provider_unissued_placeholder empty ON empty.id = i.id
    JOIN credential_ref_keyset keyset ON keyset.id = 1 AND keyset.commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
    WHERE i.pass_id = OLD.pass_id AND i.org_id = OLD.org_id AND i.mode = OLD.mode
      AND i.credential_generation = OLD.target_generation AND i.lifecycle = 'blocked'
      AND i.retirement_requested_at IS NULL AND i.provider IN ('google', 'samsung')) != 2
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances previous WHERE previous.pass_id = OLD.pass_id
    AND previous.credential_generation < OLD.target_generation
    AND (previous.org_id != OLD.org_id OR previous.mode != OLD.mode OR previous.retirement_settled_at IS NULL))
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provider retirement incomplete'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_generation_ready_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF lifecycle ON wallet_provider_instances
WHEN OLD.lifecycle = 'blocked' AND NEW.lifecycle = 'ready'
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM passes p JOIN pass_credential_transfers t ON t.pass_id = p.id
    JOIN wallet_provider_unissued_placeholder empty ON empty.id = OLD.id
    JOIN credential_ref_keyset keyset ON keyset.id = 1 AND keyset.commitment = OLD.credential_keyset_commitment
    WHERE p.id = OLD.pass_id AND p.org_id = OLD.org_id AND p.mode = OLD.mode
      AND p.credential_generation = OLD.credential_generation AND OLD.retirement_requested_at IS NULL
      AND t.org_id = p.org_id AND t.mode = p.mode AND t.target_generation = OLD.credential_generation
      AND t.state = 'completed'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers pending
        WHERE pending.pass_id = p.id AND pending.state = 'pending')
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'provider generation is blocked') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM passes p JOIN wallet_provider_instances previous ON previous.pass_id = p.id
    WHERE p.id = OLD.pass_id AND previous.credential_generation < OLD.credential_generation
      AND (previous.org_id != p.org_id OR previous.mode != p.mode
        OR previous.retirement_settled_at IS NULL)
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'provider generation is blocked') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER pass_credential_transfer_complete_guard
BEFORE UPDATE ON pass_credential_transfers
WHEN OLD.state != 'pending' OR NEW.state != 'completed'
  OR OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.pass_id IS NOT NEW.pass_id OR OLD.org_id IS NOT NEW.org_id
  OR OLD.mode IS NOT NEW.mode OR OLD.source_generation IS NOT NEW.source_generation
  OR OLD.source_version IS NOT NEW.source_version OR OLD.source_revision IS NOT NEW.source_revision
  OR OLD.source_row_version IS NOT NEW.source_row_version
  OR OLD.source_lifecycle_generation IS NOT NEW.source_lifecycle_generation
  OR OLD.source_link_generation IS NOT NEW.source_link_generation
  OR OLD.source_connection_id IS NOT NEW.source_connection_id
  OR OLD.source_connection_ref IS NOT NEW.source_connection_ref
  OR OLD.source_connection_generation IS NOT NEW.source_connection_generation
  OR OLD.source_connection_mode IS NOT NEW.source_connection_mode
  OR OLD.source_admitted_release_id IS NOT NEW.source_admitted_release_id
  OR OLD.source_admitted_release_generation IS NOT NEW.source_admitted_release_generation
  OR OLD.source_admitted_release_version IS NOT NEW.source_admitted_release_version
  OR OLD.target_holder_email IS NOT NEW.target_holder_email
  OR OLD.target_owner_user_id IS NOT NEW.target_owner_user_id
  OR OLD.requested_by_type IS NOT NEW.requested_by_type OR OLD.requested_by_id IS NOT NEW.requested_by_id
  OR OLD.requested_at IS NOT NEW.requested_at
  OR NEW.completed_at IS NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM passes p WHERE p.id = OLD.pass_id AND p.org_id = OLD.org_id
    AND p.mode = OLD.mode AND p.credential_generation = OLD.target_generation
    AND p.row_version > OLD.source_row_version
    AND p.lifecycle_generation = OLD.source_lifecycle_generation
    AND p.link_generation = OLD.source_link_generation
    AND p.holder_email IS OLD.target_holder_email AND p.owner_user_id IS OLD.target_owner_user_id)
  -- A connector transfer finishes against whatever the connection and release head are now: a connection
  -- edit or a newer approved release moves neither the binding nor the head the finish rebuilt against.
  OR (OLD.source_connection_id IS NOT NULL AND (
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfer_payloads payload WHERE payload.transfer_id = OLD.id)
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM passes p
      JOIN templates template ON template.id = p.template_id
      JOIN template_releases rel ON rel.id = p.release_id
      WHERE p.id = OLD.pass_id AND p.org_id = OLD.org_id AND p.mode = 'live'
        AND p.connection_id = OLD.source_connection_id AND p.external_ref IS OLD.source_connection_ref
        AND p.template_version = rel.version
        AND rel.template_id = p.template_id AND rel.mode = p.mode AND rel.provider = 'apple'
        AND (rel.org_id = p.org_id OR (rel.org_id IS NULL
          AND template.org_id IS NULL AND template.origin = 'baked'))
        AND ((template.status = 'active'
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_release_heads head WHERE head.release_id = rel.id))
          OR (template.status != 'deleted' AND rel.id = OLD.source_admitted_release_id))
    )
  ))
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances i
    WHERE i.pass_id = OLD.pass_id AND i.credential_generation < OLD.target_generation
      AND (i.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR i.mode IS NOT OLD.mode OR i.retirement_settled_at IS NULL))
