CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_generation_advance AFTER UPDATE OF credential_generation ON passes
WHEN NEW.credential_generation > OLD.credential_generation
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t
      WHERE t.pass_id = NEW.id AND t.org_id = NEW.org_id AND t.mode = NEW.mode AND t.state = 'pending'
        AND t.source_generation = OLD.credential_generation AND t.target_generation = NEW.credential_generation
        AND t.source_row_version = OLD.row_version
        AND t.source_lifecycle_generation = OLD.lifecycle_generation
        AND t.source_link_generation = NEW.link_generation AND NEW.link_generation = OLD.link_generation + 1
        AND NEW.download_token IS NOT OLD.download_token)
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'stale provider transfer') END;
  UPDATE wallet_provider_instances SET retirement_requested_at = MAX((SELECT requested_at
      FROM pass_credential_transfers WHERE pass_id = NEW.id AND state = 'pending'), created_at),
    updated_at = MAX((SELECT requested_at FROM pass_credential_transfers
      WHERE pass_id = NEW.id AND state = 'pending'), updated_at)
  WHERE pass_id = NEW.id AND credential_generation < NEW.credential_generation
    AND lifecycle != 'retired' AND retirement_requested_at IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credential_ref_keyset keyset WHERE keyset.id = 1
      AND keyset.commitment = wallet_provider_instances.credential_keyset_commitment)
    AND (lifecycle IN ('blocked', 'ready') OR id IN (SELECT id FROM wallet_provider_pinned_desired));
  INSERT INTO wallet_provider_instance_dirty(instance_id, generation, next_attempt_at)
    SELECT id, 1, 0 FROM wallet_provider_instances WHERE pass_id = NEW.id
      AND credential_generation < NEW.credential_generation AND lifecycle IN ('active', 'revoking', 'revoked')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credential_ref_keyset keyset WHERE keyset.id = 1
        AND keyset.commitment = wallet_provider_instances.credential_keyset_commitment)
      AND id IN (SELECT id FROM wallet_provider_pinned_desired)
    ON CONFLICT(instance_id) DO UPDATE SET generation = generation + 1, next_attempt_at = 0;
  UPDATE wallet_provider_instances SET lifecycle = 'retired', retirement_reason = 'not_issued',
    retired_at = MAX((SELECT requested_at FROM pass_credential_transfers
      WHERE pass_id = NEW.id AND state = 'pending'), created_at),
    updated_at = MAX((SELECT requested_at FROM pass_credential_transfers
      WHERE pass_id = NEW.id AND state = 'pending'), updated_at)
  WHERE pass_id = NEW.id AND credential_generation < NEW.credential_generation
    AND lifecycle IN ('blocked', 'ready')
    AND id IN (SELECT id FROM wallet_provider_unissued_placeholder)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credential_ref_keyset keyset WHERE keyset.id = 1
      AND keyset.commitment = wallet_provider_instances.credential_keyset_commitment);
  INSERT INTO wallet_provider_instances
    (id, pass_id, org_id, mode, provider, credential_generation, credential_keyset_commitment,
      lifecycle, desired_version, created_at, updated_at)
    SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), NEW.id, NEW.org_id, NEW.mode, provider, NEW.credential_generation,
      keyset.commitment, 'blocked', 0, t.requested_at, t.requested_at
    FROM pass_credential_transfers t CROSS JOIN (SELECT 'google' AS provider UNION ALL SELECT 'samsung')
      JOIN credential_ref_keyset keyset ON keyset.id = 1
    WHERE t.pass_id = NEW.id AND t.state = 'pending' AND t.target_generation = NEW.credential_generation;
  SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallet_provider_instances i
    JOIN wallet_provider_unissued_placeholder empty ON empty.id = i.id
    JOIN credential_ref_keyset keyset ON keyset.id = 1 AND keyset.commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
    WHERE i.pass_id = NEW.id AND i.org_id = NEW.org_id AND i.mode = NEW.mode
      AND i.credential_generation = NEW.credential_generation AND i.lifecycle = 'blocked'
      AND i.retirement_requested_at IS NULL AND i.provider IN ('google', 'samsung')) != 2
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid blocked provider generation') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER nfc_tag_keys_update BEFORE UPDATE ON nfc_tag_keys
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_key_fixed') WHERE NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.keyset_id IS NOT OLD.keyset_id
    OR NEW.version IS NOT OLD.version OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
    OR NEW.iv IS NOT OLD.iv OR NEW.ciphertext IS NOT OLD.ciphertext
    OR ((NEW.kek_version IS NOT OLD.kek_version OR NEW.wrapped_dek IS NOT OLD.wrapped_dek)
      AND NOT (NEW.kek_version > OLD.kek_version AND NEW.wrapped_dek IS NOT OLD.wrapped_dek));
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_key_revoked') WHERE NEW.revoked_at IS NOT OLD.revoked_at
    AND NOT (OLD.revoked_at IS NULL AND NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
      AND OLD.state IN ('active', 'retiring') AND NEW.state = 'retired');
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_key_state') WHERE NOT (NEW.state = OLD.state
    OR (OLD.state = 'active' AND NEW.state = 'retiring')
    OR (OLD.state = 'retiring' AND NEW.state = 'retired')
    OR (OLD.state = 'active' AND NEW.state = 'retired' AND (NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tag_keysets k WHERE k.id = OLD.keyset_id AND k.disabled_at IS NOT NULL))));
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_key_in_use') WHERE NEW.state = 'retired' AND OLD.state <> 'retired'
    AND NEW.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tag_sun s WHERE s.keyset_id = OLD.keyset_id AND s.key_version = OLD.version)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tag_keysets k WHERE k.id = OLD.keyset_id AND k.disabled_at IS NOT NULL);
END

CREATE TRIGGER identity_certificates_on_insert AFTER INSERT ON signing_identities
WHEN NEW.cert_sha256 IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_certificates
    WHERE identity_id = NEW.id AND cert_sha256 = NEW.cert_sha256 AND state = 'active')
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO identity_certificates
    (id, identity_id, credential_id, cert_sha256, not_before, not_after, origin, state, created_at, activated_at)
  VALUES ('idc-' || lower(hex(randomblob(16))), NEW.id, NEW.credential_id, NEW.cert_sha256, NEW.not_before,
    NEW.not_after, CASE NEW.source WHEN 'env' THEN 'env' ELSE 'upload' END, 'active',
    NEW.created_at, NEW.created_at);
END

CREATE TRIGGER identity_certificates_on_rotate AFTER UPDATE OF cert_sha256 ON signing_identities
WHEN NEW.cert_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND NEW.cert_sha256 IS NOT OLD.cert_sha256
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_certificates
    WHERE identity_id = NEW.id AND cert_sha256 = NEW.cert_sha256 AND state = 'active')
BEGIN
  UPDATE identity_certificates
    SET state = 'superseded', ended_at = CAST((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER)
    WHERE identity_id = NEW.id AND state = 'active';
  INSERT INTO identity_certificates
    (id, identity_id, credential_id, cert_sha256, not_before, not_after, origin, state, created_at, activated_at)
  VALUES ('idc-' || lower(hex(randomblob(16))), NEW.id, NEW.credential_id, NEW.cert_sha256, NEW.not_before,
    NEW.not_after, CASE NEW.source WHEN 'env' THEN 'env' ELSE 'upload' END, 'active',
    CAST((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER),
    CAST((julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER));
END

      OR (NEW.kind = 'enable' AND g.purpose = 'org_mode.wallet.enrolment_enable')

CREATE TRIGGER api_keys_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON api_keys
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id
    OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id
    OR NEW.name IS NOT OLD.name
    OR NEW.prefix IS NOT OLD.prefix
    OR NEW.key_hash IS NOT OLD.key_hash
    OR NEW.scopes IS NOT OLD.scopes
    OR NEW.mode IS NOT OLD.mode
    OR (NEW.created_by IS NOT OLD.created_by AND NOT (
      OLD.created_by IS NOT NULL AND NEW.created_by IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = OLD.created_by)
    ))
    OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
    OR NEW.expires_at IS NOT OLD.expires_at
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'api key identity is immutable') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.last_used_at IS NOT OLD.last_used_at AND (
    typeof(NEW.last_used_at) != 'integer'
    OR (OLD.last_used_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.last_used_at < OLD.last_used_at)
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'api key last use must be monotonic') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.revoked_at IS NOT OLD.revoked_at AND (
    OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR typeof(NEW.revoked_at) != 'integer'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'api key revocation is irreversible') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER nfc_tag_sun_update BEFORE UPDATE ON nfc_tag_sun
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_sun_fixed') WHERE NEW.tag_id IS NOT OLD.tag_id
    OR (OLD.kek_version IS NULL AND NEW.kek_version IS NOT NULL)
    OR (OLD.kek_version IS NOT NULL AND NEW.kek_version IS NULL)
    OR ((NEW.iv IS NOT OLD.iv OR NEW.ciphertext IS NOT OLD.ciphertext
        OR NEW.kek_version IS NOT OLD.kek_version OR NEW.wrapped_dek IS NOT OLD.wrapped_dek)
      AND NOT (NEW.kek_version IS NOT NULL AND OLD.kek_version IS NOT NULL AND NEW.kek_version > OLD.kek_version
        AND NEW.wrapped_dek IS NOT OLD.wrapped_dek AND NEW.iv IS OLD.iv AND NEW.ciphertext IS OLD.ciphertext)
      AND NOT (NEW.kek_version IS NOT NULL AND OLD.kek_version IS NOT NULL AND NEW.kek_version >= OLD.kek_version AND NEW.keyset_id IS OLD.keyset_id
        AND NEW.iv IS NOT OLD.iv AND NEW.ciphertext IS NOT OLD.ciphertext AND NEW.wrapped_dek IS NOT OLD.wrapped_dek
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tag_keysets k
          WHERE k.id = NEW.keyset_id AND k.per_tag = 1 AND k.disabled_at IS NULL
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM authority_grants g WHERE g.purpose = 'org_mode.nfc.keyset.rekey'
            AND g.org_id = k.org_id AND g.mode = k.mode))));
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_sun_move') WHERE NEW.keyset_id IS NOT OLD.keyset_id AND (
    OLD.kek_version IS NOT NULL OR NEW.ctr IS NOT OLD.ctr
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tags t
        JOIN nfc_tag_keysets k ON k.org_id = t.org_id AND k.mode = t.mode
        JOIN nfc_tag_keys y ON y.keyset_id = k.id
      WHERE t.id = NEW.tag_id AND k.id = NEW.keyset_id AND k.disabled_at IS NULL AND k.per_tag = 0
        AND y.version = NEW.key_version AND y.state = 'active'));
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_sun_ctr') WHERE NEW.ctr < OLD.ctr;
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_sun_version') WHERE NEW.keyset_id IS OLD.keyset_id AND NEW.key_version < OLD.key_version;
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'tag_key_state') WHERE NEW.key_version <> OLD.key_version AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tag_keys y WHERE y.keyset_id = NEW.keyset_id AND y.version = NEW.key_version
      AND y.state <> 'retired');
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_google_revocation_confirmations_insert BEFORE INSERT ON wallet_google_revocation_confirmations
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op
  JOIN wallet_provider_instances i ON i.id = op.instance_id
  JOIN wallet_provider_instance_outcomes o ON o.id = NEW.outcome_id AND o.operation_id = op.id
    AND o.attempt = op.attempts
  WHERE op.id = NEW.operation_id AND op.instance_id = NEW.instance_id AND op.version = NEW.version
    AND op.kind = 'revoke' AND op.state IN ('claimed', 'uncertain') AND i.provider = 'google'
    AND op.credential_keyset_commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment
    AND i.credential_keyset_commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment
    AND o.method = 'GET' AND o.stage = 'google-object'
    AND o.http_status = CASE NEW.outcome WHEN 'inactive' THEN 200 ELSE 404 END)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'google revocation confirmation needs a claimed revoke and its read back'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_instances_lifecycle_forward BEFORE UPDATE OF lifecycle ON wallet_provider_instances
WHEN (OLD.lifecycle = 'retired' AND NEW.lifecycle != 'retired')
  OR (OLD.lifecycle = 'blocked' AND NEW.lifecycle NOT IN ('blocked', 'ready', 'retired'))
  OR (OLD.lifecycle = 'ready' AND NEW.lifecycle NOT IN ('blocked', 'ready', 'active', 'retired'))
  OR (OLD.lifecycle = 'active' AND NEW.lifecycle NOT IN ('active', 'revoking'))
  OR (OLD.lifecycle = 'ready' AND NEW.lifecycle = 'blocked' AND (
    OLD.account_id IS NOT NULL OR OLD.identity_projection_release_id IS NOT NULL
    OR OLD.desired_operation_id IS NOT NULL OR OLD.desired_version != 0
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op WHERE op.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_offer_refs offer WHERE offer.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_fetch_refs ref WHERE ref.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_callback_bindings binding WHERE binding.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_callback_events event WHERE event.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_callback_receipts receipt WHERE receipt.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_callback_receipts receipt WHERE receipt.instance_id = OLD.id)
  ))
  OR (OLD.lifecycle = 'blocked' AND NEW.lifecycle = 'ready' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances predecessor WHERE predecessor.pass_id = OLD.pass_id
      AND predecessor.provider = OLD.provider AND predecessor.id != OLD.id
      AND predecessor.lifecycle NOT IN ('blocked', 'retired')
  ))
  OR (NEW.lifecycle = 'retired' AND OLD.lifecycle IN ('blocked', 'ready') AND (
    NEW.retirement_reason IS NOT 'not_issued' OR NEW.account_id IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.identity_projection_release_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.desired_operation_id IS NOT NULL
    OR NEW.desired_version != 0 OR NEW.retired_at IS NULL
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op WHERE op.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_offer_refs offer WHERE offer.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_fetch_refs ref WHERE ref.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_callback_bindings binding WHERE binding.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_callback_events event WHERE event.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_callback_receipts receipt WHERE receipt.instance_id = OLD.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_callback_receipts receipt WHERE receipt.instance_id = OLD.id)
  ))
  OR (NEW.lifecycle = 'retired' AND OLD.provider = 'google' AND OLD.desired_version > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_google_revocation_confirmations confirmed
    WHERE confirmed.operation_id = OLD.desired_operation_id AND confirmed.instance_id = OLD.id
      AND confirmed.version = OLD.desired_version
      AND confirmed.credential_keyset_commitment = OLD.credential_keyset_commitment))
  OR (NEW.lifecycle = 'retired' AND OLD.lifecycle NOT IN ('retired', 'blocked', 'ready') AND
    (OLD.lifecycle != 'revoked' OR OLD.retirement_requested_at IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op
      WHERE op.id = OLD.desired_operation_id AND op.instance_id = OLD.id
        AND op.kind = 'revoke' AND op.state = 'succeeded'
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations busy
          WHERE busy.instance_id = OLD.id AND busy.state IN ('claimed', 'uncertain'))
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_fetch_refs ref
          WHERE ref.instance_id = OLD.id AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM wallet_samsung_tombstones t WHERE t.ref_hash = ref.ref_hash
              AND t.org_id = OLD.org_id AND t.mode = OLD.mode AND t.account_id = OLD.account_id
              AND t.release_id = OLD.identity_projection_release_id
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_releases ir
                JOIN template_candidates ic ON ic.id = ir.candidate_id
                WHERE ir.id = OLD.identity_projection_release_id AND t.candidate_id = ic.id
                  AND t.account_revision = ic.provider_account_revision
                  AND t.provider_identity_hash = ic.provider_identity_hash)
          ))
    )))
  OR (OLD.lifecycle IN ('revoking', 'revoked') AND NEW.lifecycle = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op JOIN passes p ON p.id = OLD.pass_id
    WHERE OLD.retirement_requested_at IS NULL AND op.id = OLD.desired_operation_id AND op.kind = 'revoke'
      AND op.state IN ('pending', 'retry', 'failed', 'superseded', 'succeeded')
      AND p.org_id = OLD.org_id AND p.mode = OLD.mode AND p.status = 'active'
      AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.removed_at IS NULL AND p.test_data_quarantined = 0
      AND p.lifecycle_generation > op.lifecycle_generation
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations busy
        WHERE busy.instance_id = OLD.id AND busy.state IN ('claimed', 'uncertain'))
  ))
  OR (OLD.lifecycle = 'revoking' AND NEW.lifecycle NOT IN ('revoking', 'revoked', 'active'))
  OR (OLD.lifecycle = 'revoked' AND NEW.lifecycle NOT IN ('revoked', 'retired', 'active'))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provider lifecycle cannot be reversed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_samsung_tombstones_approved_insert BEFORE INSERT ON wallet_samsung_tombstones
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_accounts a JOIN wallet_provider_account_events e
    ON e.account_id = a.id AND e.org_id = a.org_id AND e.mode = a.mode AND e.provider = a.provider
    AND e.revision = NEW.account_revision AND e.kind = 'configure'
  JOIN template_candidates c ON c.id = NEW.candidate_id AND c.provider_account_id = a.id
    AND c.provider_account_revision = NEW.account_revision AND c.provider_identity_hash = NEW.provider_identity_hash
    AND c.org_id = NEW.org_id AND c.mode = NEW.mode AND c.provider = 'samsung'
  JOIN template_releases r ON r.id = NEW.release_id AND r.candidate_id = c.id
    AND r.org_id = NEW.org_id AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = 'samsung' AND r.source = 'approved'
  LEFT JOIN wallet_provider_projection_evidence_history h ON h.candidate_id = c.id AND h.org_id = c.org_id
    AND h.mode = c.mode AND h.account_id = a.id AND h.account_revision = NEW.account_revision
    AND h.provider_identity_hash = NEW.provider_identity_hash AND h.candidate_hash = c.candidate_hash
    AND h.card_type = json_extract(c.projection_json, '$.cardType')
    AND h.card_sub_type = json_extract(c.projection_json, '$.cardSubType')
    AND h.country_code = json_extract(c.projection_json, '$.countryCode')
    AND h.testing_mode_off = 'Y' AND h.verified_at <= r.created_at AND r.created_at < h.expires_at
  WHERE a.id = NEW.account_id AND a.org_id = NEW.org_id AND a.mode = NEW.mode AND a.provider = 'samsung'
    AND (json_extract(c.projection_json, '$.schema') = 2 OR h.candidate_id IS NOT NULL)
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Samsung tombstone requires verified release evidence'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_samsung_tombstone_keyset_insert BEFORE INSERT ON wallet_samsung_tombstones
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_releases projection_release
  JOIN template_candidates candidate ON candidate.id = projection_release.candidate_id
  JOIN template_approvals approval ON approval.id = projection_release.approval_id AND approval.candidate_id = candidate.id
  LEFT JOIN wallet_provider_projection_evidence_history evidence ON evidence.candidate_id = candidate.id
  JOIN credential_ref_keyset keyset ON keyset.id = 1 AND keyset.commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment
  WHERE projection_release.id = NEW.release_id AND candidate.id = NEW.candidate_id
    AND projection_release.org_id = NEW.org_id AND projection_release.mode = NEW.mode AND projection_release.provider = 'samsung'
    AND candidate.provider_account_id = NEW.account_id AND candidate.provider_account_revision = NEW.account_revision
    AND candidate.provider_identity_hash = NEW.provider_identity_hash
    AND candidate.org_id = NEW.org_id AND candidate.mode = NEW.mode AND candidate.provider = 'samsung'
    AND projection_release.source = 'approved' AND projection_release.candidate_hash = candidate.candidate_hash
    AND approval.candidate_hash = candidate.candidate_hash AND approval.reviewer_id != candidate.author_id
    AND (candidate.version_author_id IS NULL OR approval.reviewer_id != candidate.version_author_id)
    AND projection_release.credential_keyset_commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment
    AND candidate.credential_keyset_commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment
    AND approval.credential_keyset_commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment
    AND (json_extract(candidate.projection_json, '$.schema') = 2 OR (
      evidence.credential_keyset_commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment
      AND evidence.org_id = NEW.org_id AND evidence.mode = NEW.mode AND evidence.account_id = NEW.account_id
      AND evidence.account_revision = NEW.account_revision AND evidence.candidate_hash = candidate.candidate_hash
      AND evidence.provider_identity_hash = NEW.provider_identity_hash
      AND evidence.card_type = json_extract(candidate.projection_json, '$.cardType')
      AND evidence.card_sub_type = json_extract(candidate.projection_json, '$.cardSubType')
      AND evidence.country_code = json_extract(candidate.projection_json, '$.countryCode')
      AND evidence.testing_mode_off = 'Y' AND evidence.verified_at <= projection_release.created_at
      AND projection_release.created_at < evidence.expires_at)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Samsung tombstone keyset unavailable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_release_keyset_insert BEFORE INSERT ON template_releases
WHEN NEW.provider IN ('google', 'samsung') AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM template_candidates c JOIN credential_ref_keyset keyset
    ON keyset.id = 1 AND keyset.commitment = c.credential_keyset_commitment
  JOIN template_approvals approval ON approval.id = NEW.approval_id AND approval.candidate_id = c.id
  WHERE c.id = NEW.candidate_id AND c.provider = NEW.provider
    AND c.credential_keyset_commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment
    AND approval.credential_keyset_commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment
    AND (NEW.action != 'rollback' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_releases prior
      WHERE prior.id = NEW.rollback_of_release_id
        AND prior.credential_keyset_commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment)))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provider release keyset unavailable'); END

BEGIN
  UPDATE org_entitlements SET preset_revision =

CREATE TRIGGER pass_boundaries_mark AFTER INSERT ON pass_versions
WHEN NEW.pass_json IS NOT NULL AND NEW.object_key IS NOT NULL
  AND (instr(NEW.pass_json, '"upcomingPassInformation"') > 0
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_boundaries b WHERE b.pass_id = NEW.pass_id))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM passes p JOIN orgs o ON o.id = p.org_id
    WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id AND o.kind = 'developer')
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO pass_boundaries (pass_id, version, object_key, due_at)
  VALUES (NEW.pass_id, NEW.version, NEW.object_key, NEW.created_at)
  ON CONFLICT (pass_id) DO UPDATE SET version = excluded.version, object_key = excluded.object_key,
    due_at = excluded.due_at, rendered_at = 0, render = NULL, stamp = 0, attempts = 0;
END

CREATE TRIGGER template_provider_candidates_insert BEFORE INSERT ON template_candidates
WHEN NEW.provider IN ('google', 'samsung') AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM template_provider_apple_sources s
  JOIN template_versions v ON v.template_id = s.template_id AND v.version = s.version
  JOIN wallet_provider_accounts account ON account.id = NEW.provider_account_id
    AND account.org_id = NEW.org_id AND account.mode = NEW.mode AND account.provider = NEW.provider
    AND account.revision = NEW.provider_account_revision
    AND COALESCE(account.credential_id, account.credential_source_id) IS NOT NULL
    AND account.revoked_at IS NULL
  WHERE NEW.org_id IS NOT NULL AND s.id = NEW.source_release_id
    AND s.template_id = NEW.template_id AND s.mode = NEW.mode AND s.version = NEW.version
    AND (s.org_id = NEW.org_id OR (s.org_id IS NULL AND s.origin = 'baked' AND s.template_org_id IS NULL))
    AND s.generation = NEW.source_release_generation AND s.candidate_hash = NEW.source_release_hash
    AND s.content_hash = NEW.content_hash AND v.created_by IS NEW.version_author_id
    AND NEW.projection_json IS NOT NULL AND json_valid(NEW.projection_json)
    AND json_type(NEW.projection_json) = 'object'
    AND length(NEW.provider_identity_hash) = 64 AND NEW.provider_identity_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
    AND json_extract(NEW.projection_json, '$.provider') = NEW.provider
    AND NEW.adapter_revision = 1 AND NEW.audience_policy_revision = 1
    AND ((NEW.provider = 'google' AND NEW.adapter_capabilities = '["generic-text","qr-code","reviewed-artwork"]')
      OR (NEW.provider = 'samsung' AND NEW.adapter_capabilities = '["loyalty-text","qr-code","reviewed-artwork"]'))
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid provider projection candidate'); END

CREATE TRIGGER template_provider_approvals_insert BEFORE INSERT ON template_approvals
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM template_candidates c WHERE c.id = NEW.candidate_id
  AND c.provider IN ('google', 'samsung')) AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM template_candidates c JOIN template_provider_apple_sources s ON s.id = c.source_release_id
  JOIN template_versions v ON v.template_id = c.template_id AND v.version = c.version
  JOIN wallet_provider_accounts account ON account.id = c.provider_account_id
    AND account.org_id = c.org_id AND account.mode = c.mode AND account.provider = c.provider
    AND account.authority_epoch = c.provider_account_epoch
    AND COALESCE(account.credential_id, account.credential_source_id) IS NOT NULL
    AND account.revoked_at IS NULL
  WHERE c.id = NEW.candidate_id AND NEW.candidate_hash = c.candidate_hash
    AND NEW.reviewer_id != c.author_id
    AND (c.version_author_id IS NULL OR (c.author_id = 'system:wallet-projection' AND c.provider = 'google') OR NEW.reviewer_id != c.version_author_id)
    AND (NEW.reviewer_id != 'system:wallet-projection:auto' OR (c.author_id = 'system:wallet-projection' AND c.provider = 'google'
      AND json_array_length(json_extract(c.projection_json, '$.approvedOmissions')) = 0))
    AND v.created_by IS c.version_author_id AND s.template_id = c.template_id AND s.mode = c.mode
    AND s.version = c.version AND (s.org_id = c.org_id OR (s.org_id IS NULL AND s.origin = 'baked' AND s.template_org_id IS NULL))
    AND s.generation = c.source_release_generation AND s.candidate_hash = c.source_release_hash
    AND s.content_hash = c.content_hash AND c.projection_json IS NOT NULL
    AND c.adapter_revision = 1 AND c.audience_policy_revision = 1
    AND ((c.provider = 'google' AND c.adapter_capabilities = '["generic-text","qr-code","reviewed-artwork"]')
      OR (c.provider = 'samsung' AND c.adapter_capabilities = '["loyalty-text","qr-code","reviewed-artwork"]'))
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'stale provider projection source'); END

CREATE TRIGGER template_provider_releases_insert BEFORE INSERT ON template_releases
WHEN NEW.provider IN ('google', 'samsung')
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source != 'approved' OR NEW.org_id IS NULL
    OR NEW.generation != COALESCE((SELECT MAX(r.generation) FROM template_releases r
      WHERE r.template_id = NEW.template_id AND r.org_id = NEW.org_id
        AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider), 0) + 1
    OR NEW.previous_release_id IS NOT (SELECT r.id FROM template_releases r
      WHERE r.template_id = NEW.template_id AND r.org_id = NEW.org_id
        AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider ORDER BY r.generation DESC LIMIT 1)
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'stale provider release') END;
  -- Validate the same immutable candidate in bounded predicates: combining the expanded
  -- Apple source view and nested provider evidence exceeds D1's expression-depth limit.
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM template_candidates c JOIN template_approvals a ON a.candidate_id = c.id
    JOIN template_versions v ON v.template_id = c.template_id AND v.version = c.version
    JOIN wallet_provider_accounts account ON account.id = c.provider_account_id
      AND account.org_id = c.org_id AND account.mode = c.mode AND account.provider = c.provider
      AND account.authority_epoch = c.provider_account_epoch
      AND COALESCE(account.credential_id, account.credential_source_id) IS NOT NULL
      AND account.revoked_at IS NULL
    WHERE c.id = NEW.candidate_id AND a.id = NEW.approval_id AND c.template_id = NEW.template_id
      AND c.org_id = NEW.org_id AND c.mode = NEW.mode AND c.provider = NEW.provider AND c.version = NEW.version
      AND c.candidate_hash = NEW.candidate_hash AND a.candidate_hash = c.candidate_hash
      AND c.content_hash = NEW.content_hash AND c.adapter_revision = NEW.adapter_revision
      AND c.adapter_capabilities = NEW.adapter_capabilities AND c.audience_policy_revision = NEW.audience_policy_revision
      AND a.reviewer_id != c.author_id
      AND (c.version_author_id IS NULL OR (c.author_id = 'system:wallet-projection' AND c.provider = 'google') OR a.reviewer_id != c.version_author_id)
      AND (a.reviewer_id != 'system:wallet-projection:auto' OR (c.author_id = 'system:wallet-projection' AND NEW.created_by = 'system:wallet-projection:auto'
        AND json_array_length(json_extract(c.projection_json, '$.approvedOmissions')) = 0))
      AND NEW.created_by IS NOT NULL
      AND v.created_by IS c.version_author_id AND c.projection_json IS NOT NULL
      AND json_extract(c.projection_json, '$.schema') = 2
      AND c.adapter_revision = 1 AND c.audience_policy_revision = 1
      AND ((c.provider = 'google' AND c.adapter_capabilities = '["generic-text","qr-code","reviewed-artwork"]')
        OR (c.provider = 'samsung' AND c.adapter_capabilities = '["loyalty-text","qr-code","reviewed-artwork"]'))
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid provider release approval or source') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM template_candidates c
    JOIN template_provider_apple_sources s ON s.id = c.source_release_id
    WHERE c.id = NEW.candidate_id
      AND s.template_id = c.template_id AND s.mode = c.mode AND s.version = c.version
      AND (s.org_id = c.org_id OR (s.org_id IS NULL AND s.origin = 'baked' AND s.template_org_id IS NULL))
      AND s.generation = c.source_release_generation AND s.candidate_hash = c.source_release_hash
      AND s.content_hash = c.content_hash
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid provider release approval or source') END;
  -- Operator review is not provider proof. A Samsung release needs a fresh card-state row from a live read;
  -- Google has no documented status proof, so its release rests on the compiled pins checked above.
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.provider = 'samsung' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM template_candidates c JOIN wallet_samsung_card_state st ON st.candidate_id = c.id
    WHERE c.id = NEW.candidate_id AND st.candidate_hash = c.candidate_hash
      AND st.account_id = c.provider_account_id AND st.account_epoch = c.provider_account_epoch
      AND st.card_type = json_extract(c.projection_json, '$.type')
      AND ((st.state = 'ACTIVE' AND st.testing_mode_off = 'Y') OR (NEW.mode = 'test' AND st.state IN ('ACTIVE', 'DRAFT', 'VERIFYING', 'VERIFIED')))
      AND st.verified_at <= NEW.created_at AND NEW.created_at < st.expires_at
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid provider release approval or source') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.action = 'release' AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM template_releases r WHERE r.candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id AND r.source = 'approved'
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'provider candidate already released') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.action = 'rollback' AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM template_releases r WHERE r.id = NEW.rollback_of_release_id AND r.source = 'approved'
      AND r.template_id = NEW.template_id AND r.org_id = NEW.org_id AND r.mode = NEW.mode
      AND r.provider = NEW.provider AND r.generation < NEW.generation - 1
      AND r.candidate_id = NEW.candidate_id AND r.approval_id = NEW.approval_id
      AND r.candidate_hash = NEW.candidate_hash AND r.version = NEW.version
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid provider rollback') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.adapter_revision < COALESCE((
    SELECT r.adapter_revision FROM template_releases r WHERE r.template_id = NEW.template_id
      AND r.org_id = NEW.org_id AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider
    ORDER BY r.generation DESC LIMIT 1), 0) OR NEW.audience_policy_revision < COALESCE((
    SELECT r.audience_policy_revision FROM template_releases r WHERE r.template_id = NEW.template_id
      AND r.org_id = NEW.org_id AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider
    ORDER BY r.generation DESC LIMIT 1), 0) THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'stale provider policy') END;
END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_instances_successor BEFORE INSERT ON wallet_provider_instances
WHEN NEW.channel_epoch > 1 AND (
  NEW.lifecycle != 'active' OR NEW.retirement_requested_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.retirement_cause IS NOT NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credential_ref_keyset keyset WHERE keyset.id = 1
    AND keyset.commitment = NEW.credential_keyset_commitment)
  OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM passes p WHERE p.id = NEW.pass_id AND p.org_id = NEW.org_id AND p.mode = NEW.mode
    AND p.credential_generation = NEW.credential_generation)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers pending WHERE pending.pass_id = NEW.pass_id
    AND pending.state = 'pending')
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_accounts a
    JOIN template_releases r ON r.id = NEW.identity_projection_release_id
      AND r.org_id = NEW.org_id AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider AND r.source = 'approved'
    JOIN template_candidates c ON c.id = r.candidate_id AND c.provider_account_id = a.id
      AND c.provider_account_revision = a.revision
    WHERE a.id = NEW.account_id AND a.org_id = NEW.org_id AND a.mode = NEW.mode
      AND a.provider = NEW.provider AND COALESCE(a.credential_id, a.credential_source_id) IS NOT NULL AND a.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND (a.credential_source_id IS NULL OR (a.enabled_at IS NOT NULL AND a.platform_hold_at IS NULL))
  )
  OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances pred
    WHERE pred.pass_id = NEW.pass_id AND pred.provider = NEW.provider
      AND pred.credential_generation = NEW.credential_generation AND pred.channel_epoch = NEW.channel_epoch - 1
      AND pred.org_id = NEW.org_id AND pred.mode = NEW.mode
      AND pred.retirement_cause = 'channel_off' AND pred.lifecycle IN ('revoked', 'retired')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations op WHERE op.id = pred.desired_operation_id
        AND op.instance_id = pred.id AND op.kind = 'revoke' AND op.state = 'succeeded')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instance_operations busy WHERE busy.instance_id = pred.id
        AND busy.state IN ('pending', 'retry', 'claimed', 'uncertain'))
  )
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_channels c WHERE c.pass_id = NEW.pass_id AND c.channel = NEW.provider
    AND c.retired_at IS NOT NULL)
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provider successor is not allowed'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_instances_binding_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF account_id, identity_projection_release_id ON wallet_provider_instances
WHEN (OLD.account_id IS NOT NEW.account_id OR OLD.identity_projection_release_id IS NOT NEW.identity_projection_release_id)
  AND NOT (OLD.lifecycle = 'ready' AND NEW.lifecycle = 'active'
    AND OLD.account_id IS NULL AND OLD.identity_projection_release_id IS NULL
    AND NEW.account_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.identity_projection_release_id IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_accounts a
      JOIN template_releases r ON r.id = NEW.identity_projection_release_id
        AND r.org_id = NEW.org_id AND r.mode = NEW.mode AND r.provider = NEW.provider AND r.source = 'approved'
      JOIN template_candidates c ON c.id = r.candidate_id AND c.provider_account_id = a.id
        AND c.provider_account_epoch = a.authority_epoch
      JOIN wallet_provider_instance_operations op ON op.id = NEW.desired_operation_id
        AND op.instance_id = NEW.id AND op.version = NEW.desired_version AND op.kind = 'upsert'
        AND op.pass_credential_generation = NEW.credential_generation
      WHERE a.id = NEW.account_id AND a.org_id = NEW.org_id AND a.mode = NEW.mode
        AND a.provider = NEW.provider AND COALESCE(a.credential_id, a.credential_source_id) IS NOT NULL AND a.revoked_at IS NULL
    ))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provider instance binding is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER wallet_provider_generation_operation_guard BEFORE INSERT ON wallet_provider_instance_operations
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances i JOIN passes p ON p.id = i.pass_id
  WHERE i.id = NEW.instance_id AND i.lifecycle IN ('active', 'revoking', 'revoked')
    AND i.account_id IS NOT NULL AND p.org_id = i.org_id AND p.mode = i.mode
    AND NEW.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
    AND i.credential_generation <= p.credential_generation
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t WHERE t.pass_id = p.id
      AND t.state = 'pending' AND t.source_generation = p.credential_generation)
    AND (NEW.kind = 'revoke' OR (i.lifecycle = 'active' AND i.retirement_requested_at IS NULL
      AND p.row_version = NEW.pass_row_version
      AND NEW.account_epoch = (SELECT a.authority_epoch FROM wallet_provider_accounts a WHERE a.id = i.account_id)
      AND p.lifecycle_generation = NEW.lifecycle_generation
      AND p.credential_generation = NEW.pass_credential_generation
      AND p.credential_generation = i.credential_generation
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t WHERE t.pass_id = p.id AND t.state = 'pending')))
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_instances i JOIN passes p ON p.id = i.pass_id
  WHERE i.id = NEW.instance_id AND NEW.kind = 'upsert' AND NEW.version = 1
    AND i.lifecycle = 'ready' AND i.account_id IS NULL AND i.retirement_requested_at IS NULL
    AND p.org_id = i.org_id AND p.mode = i.mode
    AND NEW.credential_keyset_commitment = i.credential_keyset_commitment
    AND p.row_version = NEW.pass_row_version
    AND p.lifecycle_generation = NEW.lifecycle_generation
    AND p.credential_generation = NEW.pass_credential_generation
    AND p.credential_generation = i.credential_generation
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pass_credential_transfers t WHERE t.pass_id = p.id AND t.state = 'pending')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM wallet_provider_accounts a
      JOIN template_releases r ON r.id = NEW.projection_release_id
        AND r.org_id = i.org_id AND r.mode = i.mode AND r.provider = i.provider AND r.source = 'approved'
      JOIN template_candidates c ON c.id = r.candidate_id AND c.provider_account_id = a.id
        AND c.provider_account_epoch = a.authority_epoch
      WHERE a.org_id = i.org_id AND a.mode = i.mode AND a.provider = i.provider
        AND COALESCE(a.credential_id, a.credential_source_id) IS NOT NULL AND a.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND NEW.account_epoch = a.authority_epoch
    )
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'provider operation is not authorized'); END

CREATE TRIGGER memberships_revoke_cancels_broadcasts AFTER UPDATE OF revoked_at ON org_memberships
WHEN NEW.revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM authority_grants g WHERE g.purpose = 'org.member.roles' AND g.target_id = NEW.id)
BEGIN
  UPDATE broadcasts SET state = 'cancelled', error_code = 'CREATOR_REVOKED',
    finished_at = CAST(unixepoch('subsec') * 1000 AS INTEGER)
  WHERE created_by_type = 'user' AND created_by_id = NEW.user_id AND org_id = NEW.org_id
    AND state = 'scheduled';
END

CREATE TRIGGER org_memberships_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON org_memberships
WHEN NEW.id IS NOT OLD.id OR NEW.org_id IS NOT OLD.org_id OR NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id
  OR NEW.invitation_id IS NOT OLD.invitation_id OR NEW.roles IS NOT OLD.roles OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
  OR NEW.joined_at IS NOT OLD.joined_at
  OR OLD.revoked_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.revoked_at IS NULL
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'immutable membership'); END
